The Bondi community is rocked when a brawl takes place at the North End. A lifeguard race adds to the action. Harries and Tommy are involved in rescues... but can Tommy successfully back up Harries?

2016 dawns on Bondi with drug and alcohol-affected masses taking lifeguards to another level. A 300-person-strong Dutch contingent raises the stakes even further. Nicola loses her cool with beachgoers, and Singlets and Mario lose their cool with each other.

A bluebottle attack turns the Bondi tower into a makeshift emergency ward. A tourist is stung mid-rescue. Lifeguards share a wave with blind surfer Derek Rabelo. Mouse handles the tower with a missing boy, a man with a dislocated shoulder, and a young woman overdosing on drugs.

During storm season, a tornado hits Southern Sydney. Tourists brave the waves at Bondi. Jesse, alone in the tower, can't assist a drowning man as all lifeguards are busy in the water. Two thrill-seekers encounter trouble in the big swell, and a British rapper embraces the storm to feel the music.

Big wave surfer Jesse challenges Tommy and Jules. Tommy performs two rescues of intoxicated tourists. Reidy pursues a creepy guy on the beach. There are Beard Season skin checks, and a Danish backpacker bares all on Bondi Beach.

Tommy showcases the art of rescue in the funniest moment of the season. An unmanned boat drifts off Bondi. Troy rescues a young girl in front of the tower with her dad unaware of the dilemma. Glick takes Kerrbox, who is afraid of heights, up in a helicopter.

Big swell and powerful rips at Bondi's south corner. Lifeguard Yatesy attempts the rescue of an inexperienced surfer in 10-foot swell. Meanwhile, increased shark sightings prompt the lifeguards to test new deterrent technology for the future safety of Bondi swimmers and lifeguards.

The biggest mass rescue at Bondi in years sees over 40 swimmers in trouble, the beach closed and lifeguards stretched to their limits. Former pro surfer Nicola Atherton is the 4th ever female lifeguard to join the team. She finds herself on the frontline of a mass rescue.

After 10 years of service, Maxi bids farewell to full-time lifeguarding to pursue his childhood dream of becoming a firefighter. Using his recent training, Maxi responds to a tunnel fire at North Bondi. Harrison and Jethro attend to a girl found facedown with no pulse. A German tourist has a dislocated shoulder.

A woman walks naked on the beach, discarding towels offered by Harries before strolling onto the Bondi streets. Another woman is removed by police for drunkenly harassing beachgoers. And lifeguards build the wildest boats imaginable for the end of season 'Surf-en-tag' wave riding competition."

The new season at Bondi introduces fresh faces with trainee Ryan, Maxi's cousin, who struggles with the megaphone. New recruit Chris from Western Australia faces a life-and-death situation. Mario tackles his first mass rescue on the jet ski. Young Jethro hits it off with a pair of drag queens.
New team members are thrown in the deep end when a series of monster waves land on Bondi. Boo and Lachie battle the dangerous conditions as they embark upon a mass rescue.

The national borders are open and international tourists flock to Bondi. Hoppo picks a random beachgoer to demonstrate his Float To Survive technique. Chase meets a local diver who invites him to check out Bondi's grey nurse shark colony.

Lifeguards investigate an unidentified floating object a kilometre offshore. Harries loses his cool with a tourist. Mario rescues a woman clinging to an inflatable tomato. Deano introduces a new training technique - submersion in an ice bath.

Chappo and H-man cautiously prepare a 19 year old German tourist for hospital after he's broken his back. Trainees Taco and Jesse have a difficult day in class struggling with the books, but get a chance to make the grade against the rest of the team in the annual lifeguard challenge.

In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

Word of their find reaches bandit McCracken (Gene Evans), who comes after them. The men hide their treasure and fend off McCracken with the help of Doc Gates (Chill Wills), before escaping to recover at the ranch of Rainbolt's friend, Amos Gondora (Robert Middleton), waiting until they can retrieve the gold.

Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline.

A low-level Washington, D.C., public servant, Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), is thrust into the national spotlight when he's asked by Martin Geller (Dylan Baker), the head of the Democratic Party, to run for president after the party's presidential and vice-presidential nominees are killed in a plane crash. The odds are against Gilliam, mostly because he has a penchant for telling the truth about what is wrong with the country. Remarkably, his straight-talking style catches on with the public.

When Rita begins suffering from crippling hallucinations, she calls upon Dr. Zeko (Zakes Mokae), an occultist who suspects a vampire is on the loose.

Everybody looks up to Pootie except evil Dick Lecter (Robert Vaughn), CEO of Lecter Corp., a company that makes cigarettes, alcohol and fast food. Pootie shows cool determination and strength to prevail over Lecter and his minions.

With only interns left staffing the emergency room, a pregnant woman involved in a traffic accident is rushed in after going into cardiac arrest, leaving the interns paralyzed by a life-or-death decision. Meanwhile, as Daeje remains unconscious, a board meeting is convened to discuss the appointment of an interim chairperson.

Appointed as interim chairperson, Jaein struggles to address the hospital's most urgent issues, only to face resistance and noncooperation from multiple departments. At the same time, a Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service officer demands objective evidence from Inhyuk and Minwoo to justify the emergency drug administration.

When the pregnant patient falls into another critical emergency, Minwoo and Inhyuk rush in to treat her—but her condition rapidly deteriorates to a perilous state. Meanwhile, government helicopter support falls through, and a cascade of internal crises begins to close in on Jaein.

Although helicopter support from the Ministry of Health falls through, discussions begin on using aircraft from the National Fire Agency. Frustrated by the officials' lack of cooperation, Inhyuk grows increasingly exasperated. Meanwhile, several department chiefs follow Seheon's junior out for a yacht outing—only to be involved in a serious traffic accident.

As the department heads argue over who should operate on a critically injured patient, Minwoo bluntly asks whether they should call Professor Choi Inhyuk. While everyone stares in disbelief, the patient is swiftly transferred to the operating room. Elsewhere, the interns submit applications to the departments they hope to join.

After performing emergency treatment on a school athletic field, Inhyuk and Minwoo rush back to the hospital—only to find no operating room available. Forced to improvise, the hospital decides to rotate surgeries to free up space. In the end, Inhyuk and Minwoo perform life-saving emergency procedures inside a violently shaking helicopter.

Do Hyun begins to recall his lost memories, while Ri On decides to investigate who was behind Ri Jin's childhood abduction. Ri Jin tries to recall her own past for Do Hyun's sake, but he worries for her. Hwa Ran panics when Do Hyun declares he'll make her illness public.
Do Hyun takes Ri Jin on a farewell trip aboard the Snow Flower Train. Shin Hwa Ran plots to ensure Do Hyun stays with Seung Jin Group, while Chairwoman Seo Tae Im meets privately with Ri Jin.

Do Hyun and Ri Jin recall the shocking truth about their past and fall into panic. Tae Im becomes busy trying to suppress an article about Jun Pyo, while Hwa Ran smiles in satisfaction. Meanwhile, Do Hyun learns from Tae Im the full story behind the fire at the Seung Jin mansion 21 years ago.

Gi Joon starts gathering all available information on Do Hyun. Ri Jin and Ri On calmly handle the sudden appearance of all of Do Hyun's personalities. Meanwhile, Do Hyun receives full authority from Tae Im to prepare for the shareholders' meeting, prompting Gi Joon to meet Young Pyo to strike a new deal.

Gi Joon and Chae Yeon are shocked to learn that Do Hyun has dissociative identity disorder, while Ri On feels uneasy about Ri Jin returning to Do Hyun's side. Meanwhile, Perry Park bids Ri Jin farewell, and traces of a new personality, “Mr. X,” begin to emerge.

Do Hyun hesitates to face the truth that Jun Pyo may have been behind Ri Jin's mother's death. Mr. X advises Do Hyun to confront his past for the sake of his future. Meanwhile, one by one, Do Hyun's personalities appear to say goodbye, and Ri Jin finally faces her childhood self.

As Jeongi explains the shape of a wine cup, Gwanghae finds his gaze drawn to her lips and abruptly excuses himself, flustered by his own reaction. Later, Gangcheon is stunned to discover Euldam's pottery at the merchant guild and asks Hwa-ryeong whether Jeongi is truly Euldam's daughter. Taedo quietly observes Jeongi and Gwanghae sitting side by side before the kiln. On the day of the Giroyeon banquet, Jeongi grows increasingly anxious when the vessels fail to arrive at the hall.

Upon discovering that Jeongi is Euldam's daughter, Gangcheon expels her from the Bunwon workshop. In front of everyone, Mun Saseung kneels and begs Gangcheon to spare her. When Hwa-ryeong declares that she will live solely to defeat Jeongi, Taedo is left shaken. Soon after, Jeongi is ordered to craft a porcelain vase as a birthday gift for Royal Consort Inbin, and Gwanghae promises to support her with everything he has.

Startled by the sound of vases shattering inside the kiln, Jeongi peers inside and suddenly collapses. Hearing that Jeongi had been guarding the kiln alone, Gwanghae turns pale and desperately searches for her. Taedo watches over the unconscious Jeongi with quiet anguish. Seeing Jeongi injured, her eyesight damaged, Gwanghae is overcome with pain—yet Jeongi asks only to be allowed back into the Bunwon.

Claiming she has no lingering attachment, Jeongi leaves the Bunwon behind, and Gwanghae watches her go in hollow disbelief. After returning to her former home, Jeongi and Taedo are suddenly seized by military officers, who drag Taedo away. Gwanghae pleads with Inbin to release him, insisting that Taedo once served as his personal guard. Awakened by her mother Yeonok's voice, Jeongi rises and walks toward the kiln…

King Seonjo orders Gwanghae, Imhae, and Shinseong to find a way to end the people's widespread stomach illness, prompting Gwanghae to disguise himself and investigate in secret. While surveying the village, he unexpectedly encounters Jeongi, who is making and distributing bowls to the villagers. Jeongi carefully presents a vessel she crafted especially for Gwanghae. Soon, a royal decree is issued for the Bunwon to produce pottery for the common people, and Gwanghae sets out to find Jeongi.

Despite Taedo's warnings that it is dangerous, Jeongi insists she must remain at the Bunwon to bring Gangcheon down from his nangcheong post. Reunited with Jeongi at the workshop, Gwanghae cannot hide his quiet delight. Meanwhile, Yukdo grows uneasy when he is forced to compete with Jeongi to create the lid for King Seonjo's cherished jar. He promises Jeongi that if she succeeds, he will elevate her to the rank of master potter.

When the temps are soaring and turning on your stove or oven is not even an option, Frankie's no cook meals will blow you away. Enjoy refreshing, nourishing dishes that will help keep you cool all summer long.

On this special delivery episode of Struggle Meals, Frankie explores three ways to make delicious pizzas, and shares clever tips to make an A+ pie without dropping your dough on expensive ingredients.

Bonsoir, indeed! Join Frankie as he cooks up elegant but achievable French classics that will transport you to an evening on the Seine, complete with some savvy wine tips without the hefty cost of a plane ticket.

Start a new tradition at the dinner table this year with a meat free spin on your favorite main courses. Learn new tips and tricks to make your veggie forward dinner so delightful that even the biggest meat eaters will be back for seconds.

programmes.st: Meat: More Bang for Your Buck
programmes.d: Frankie shows which cuts of meat provide the most bang for a consumer's buck, and equally important, how to cook them for optimal flavor.

Frankie busts the myth that eating plant-based is expensive. Preparing these good-for-you meals is all about eating seasonally to save money on produce, and shopping the bulk aisle for even more savings on plant-based pantry items.

Frankie figured out the weekly budget grocery equation so you don't have to. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner for seven days, for a family of four, for under $150. All it takes is a little planning, meal prep, and using up leftovers in inventive ways.

Cheese can be really expensive. Frankie teaches us how to cook with more affordable cheese swaps than what might normally be called for in a recipe. More importantly, we learn how to stretch cheese in a dish so it can be the star.

Tomatoes are one of the most produced fruits, especially when in season. Frankie teaches us how to prepare them fresh in a variety of ways. And for even more savings, Frankie will share a few tips on how to preserve tomatoes.

Date night doesn't have to be at an over-priced, mediocre restaurant. Frankie prepares an affordable and delicious sushi date night at home, filled with three courses, plus tips on how to set date night ambiance at home on a struggle budget.

A big way to save money on a struggle budget is to prepare homemade lunches for work. Frankie shows us how to make five delicious lunches for the whole work week. Each one flavored differently during meal prep so you don't get bored.

Flour has the superpower to transform into an endless variety of meals, and a little goes a long way. Frankie teaches us how to make three different meals using flour as the affordable vehicle. Save money, learn new techniques.

You say hot dishes, Frankie says casserole. Either way, these one-pot hot dishes are an affordable way to feed a group of people, or the family for dinner. Plus they're great to freeze for future meals.

Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires  they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.
Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.
At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.
Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.
The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programmes.st: Cold Hard Toenails/Attack of the Blobs

programmes.st: Chip Off the Old Beast/The War's Over

programmes.st: Where Have All The Monsters Gone?
programmes.d: The scare meter and hall of records informs the Gromble that monster scares are not as effective as they used to be in the human world.  This poses a problem to the monster race as it exists.
He's Baaaaaaack!  The relentless Simon the Monster Hunter is up to his old trick with new traps.  Gromble's students think he's all wet when he tells them about their legacy--the Pool of Elders.

Ickis is diagnosed as spontaneously combustible which means he could explode at any moment. His friends feel sorry for him, but at the same time are reluctant to be near him for fear that he could "go at any moment."

programmes.st: Monsters Are Real / This is your Brain on Ickis
programmes.d: An overzealous news photographer accidentally takes a picture of Ickis while trying to capture one of a rock star.  Ickis, while trying to give Simon the Monster Hunter a nightmare, gets sucked into his brain.

programmes.st: Into The Woods/Krumm Gets The Dreaded Nolox
programmes.d: Ickis has to perform a group scare so he turns to a human he knows for help.   Krumm gets a bad case of hiccoughs known to monsters as The Dreaded Nolox.  It's up to Oblina and Ickis to find a cure.

programmes.st: Mayberry U.F.O. / I Dream of Snorch with the Long Golden Hair

On a beautiful spring day, Ickis, Krumm and Oblina frolic in a fresh pile of garbage only to find that they have inadvertently boarded a garbage barge headed for the wide open seas.

programmes.st: Monster Who Came in from the Cold / Puppy Ciao
programmes.d: Oblina infiltrates the human race in a "human suit."  When the suit malfunctions, and she thinks she's human, Ickis and Krumm have to rescue her.  While above the ground, a puppy saves Ickis from being run over.

Oblina, long used to being the star pupil, finds herself challenged to the limit by a gifted transfer student from another dump.  Ickis steals a magicians hat, assuming that its powers will make him the most popular monster at the academy.
When a human designer realeases a new fragrance, the monsters discover it works as a toxic gas against them.  Oblina's not superstitious, but when she  steps on a slug her luck changes.
When the viewfinder stops working, Ickism Oblina and Krumm tell very different versions of the same scare.  Ickis eats a seed that grew on a tree, and soon finds he's turning into a tree himself.

programmes.st: History Of The Monster World, Part One / Fear Thy Name Is Ickis
programmes.d: The Gromble teaches students about their proud heritage.  A famous artist creates a huge statue entitled "Fear," which is actually a clay sculpture of a looming Ickis.

programmes.st: The Quest For the Holy Pail / Garbage In, Garbage Out
programmes.d: Ickis is chosen by mysterious forces as the monster who quests for the holy pail - the most sacred of monster objects.  When the city mayor declares a "Dump the Dump" recycling effort, the lack of garbage causes a crisis at the Academy.

programmes.st: A Room With No Viewfinder / Krumm Rises To The Top
programmes.d: Desperate to avoid being strapped to the viewfinder, Ickis attemps to dismantle it - and the viewfinder escapes.  Ickis and Oblina find themselves monster-sitting a swollen, helium-voiced and cranky Krumm when he swallow a helium tank.

programmes.st: The Five Faces of Ickis / Bigfoot, Don't Fail Me Now
programmes.d: The Gromble insists that Ickis come up with five scares in one day.  Ickis lets a huckster clone him five times so he can get the job done.  Simon the Monster Hunter is hot on the trail of Bigfoot, who turns out to be one of the Gromble's ex-students.

programmes.st: Festival of the Festering Moon / Simon's Big Score

programmes.st: Who'll Stop the Brain? / Cement Heads

programmes.st: Ickis and The Red Zimbo / Oblina and the Three Humans

Ickis, Krumm, and Oblina are saddled with babysitting the Gromble's infant nephew -- Bomble.   A new carnival opens near town and The Gromble is insulted and outraged by one of its attractions -- the "Monsters Are Fun" ride.

programmes.st: Out of the Past / Ship of Fools
programmes.d: Ickis is in the middle of a botched scare on the viewfinder when The Gromble sees the dreaded "Jolly Rooter Sewer Service."   Oblina is left in charge when the Gromble goes off to the Annual Academy Teachers Convention, and power goes to her head.

Tonight, it's the first Power of Veto competition of the summer.
Tonight, a house guest is evicted; the remaining house guests compete for next head of household.

When a rat gets lost in the home, Kevin scurries to care for it. Meanwhile, an ex-flame creates surging tension between Lindsey and Gigi.
Suzanne isn't a sport when Nick watches a game with friends at a sports bar with alluring waitresses. Elsewhere, the children ask for more allowance, but they reject doing any added chores.
Suzanne becomes a viral-video sensation after she's caught dancing on camera. Meanwhile, Marilyn serves up soul-food lessons to young Lindsey.
Lindsey taps into her mother's credit card to order a sweater. Elsewhere, Kevin feigns being ill to score a coveted baseball jersey.
An exhausted Nick resists Suzanne's romantic advances, leading her to worry about the health of their relationship.
Nick recommends throwing a social event with family and friends in a bid to strengthen family ties, but his sloppy planning results in chaos.
When Suzanne's ex-husband wants to lower his monthly child support payments, Nick jumps at the chance to get rid of Frank's financial support, while Suzanne has mixed feelings about Frank.

programmes.st: The We Ain't Going Out Like That Episode
programmes.d: When Nick tries to be spontaneous, but Suzanne resists and instead plans a date night that fails, they attempt to be spontaneous together--until they realize it's better if she makes plan.

programmes.st: The Oh No She Di-in't Episode
programmes.d: Suzanne grows jealous of Nick's pretty young field producer. Elsewhere, Gigi falls for a man, who has children, so she enlists Kevin and Lindsey to help her better relate to kids.
Suzanne infiltrates Nick's night with the boys, so he retaliates by crashing her all-lady spa getaway.
When Marilyn throws a gold party at Nick and Suzanne's, and Nick learns Suzanne's wedding ring isn't real, he sets out to have a real ring made before Suzanne learns the truth.
When Suzanne suspects that Lindsey's athletic new crush from school is gay, Nick sets out to prove that he isn't.

programmes.st: The Man and the Bragging Snafu Episode
programmes.d: When Nick's colleague at the station encourages him to send Lindsey and Kevin to a private school, Nick and Suzanne look into it, only to be misled about the process.
Suzanne becomes overly consumed with Kevin's science project. Elsewhere, Lindsey revs up for driving lessons, only to emerge as a suspect when her mother's car is scratched.
Lindsey's romantic attentions turn to a young celebrity DJ, who only neglects her in return. Elsewhere, Suzanne teaches Kevin the art of doing laundry. Michael Strahan and Lil JJ guest star.

programmes.st: The She Got Game Night Episode
programmes.d: When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.
Nick flops in his efforts to help Kevin with Valentine's Day at school.
Suzanne serves on a committee at Kevin's school, but complications arise when her fellow female members disrespect her---but adore Nick.

programmes.st: The Whose Card Is It Anyway Episode
programmes.d: When Nick misleads Suzanne about spending a gift card, the couple appear before a TV judge to sort out the truth.
Nick plans a belated surprise honeymoon for Suzanne, but keeping it a secret causes complications. Elsewhere, Lindsey helps Kevin with his homework.
Hattie prepares for spring cleaning at the diner; Linda explains why she can't move in with Phillip.
Linda threatens to call the wedding off if Philip does not change the furniture in his house.
Philip allows Linda to redecorate the house in whatever way she chooses.

Linda asks Hattie if she'll stay and help her when the baby comes, because she doubts that Philip will help with the newborn.

Troy and Danny inevitably do something stupid in Las Vegas. In the last minute, Linda's water breaks while she is 6 months pregnant.

Troy and Sam zero in on Danny.
Danny has to deal with how his friends and family feel about his wife.
Philip learns the basics of pregnancy.
Danny struggles with his mother's absence.
Hattie tries to force Linda and Troy to discuss their differences.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Peace Out, America!
programmes.d: The crew throws a going-away party for Mama Bae, Alex moves into Donna's place, Ceaser receives devastating news, and Sky hosts the grand opening of her shop in Miami.
Sky enlists the crew to help with her fashion show in L.A., Miss Kitty and Young Bae talk about their fight, Alex surprises Donna, and Tatiana reaches her breaking point.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Runner Up For Mother Teresa Number 2
programmes.d: Ceaser reunites with an enemy, Krystal has a much-needed talk with her father, and Sky's twerk fashion show includes a surprise that sends Ceaser over the edge.
Free jackets get in the way of Ceaser squashing his beef with Alex, Tokie refuses to accept peace between Tati and Krystal, and Sky plows ahead with Operation Mend Fences.

After mending fences with Puma, Cease makes him a partner at 113th only to have his decision be questioned during his 40th birthday celebration. Bae struggles to keep her marriage together, while Sky confronts her son Des, about his recent behavior.
Walt brings his new girlfriend by the shop, which causes Donna to catch a flashback. Young Bae and Rob face difficulties in their marriage. Sky is at a crossroads with her relationship with Des.
Kit's mom passes away in D.C and the news rocks the shop. Donna and Walt duke it out over Jessica. Puma hires new girl London and Bae thinks he has a shady, ulterior motive.

Puma hires London to cover for Kitty which disrupts the precarious balance in the shop. Tati has a run in with the law and Donna faces a major financial setback. Puma tries to bring a little kumbaya to 113 but no good deed goes unpunished.

In an effort to support Miss Kitty, Ceaser and the crew head down to Memphis, Tennessee so she can reconnect with her mother's roots. Krystal confronts Donna about her behavior during the lock-in. And Walt makes a serious go at standup comedy.

The crew continues their stay in Memphis to pay their respects to Kitty's mom. London decides to throw a house party to promote the brand down south. Walt prepares to take his relationship with Jessica to the next step.

Ceaser has a new opportunity to expand Black Ink but not everyone is happy with the deal, leaving him to question where loyalties lie. Donna plans a girls' night that's full of rowdy surprises. Walt and Jess can't see eye to eye.

Following Frank’s dinner with mob lawyer Angelo Gallo, Gallo is shot, and Frank narrowly escapes with his own life. Meanwhile, Danny is called for jury duty and winds up being the sole dissenting opinion in a murder trial.
Danny and Baez investigate a homicide in which Baez’s estranged brother, a former drug addict, is the lead suspect.
Danny and Baez investigate a homicide in which Baez’s estranged brother, a former drug addict, is the lead suspect.
Danny and Baez investigate a local bombing but meet with tension and resistance from the community during the investigation.
Danny’s loyalty is tested when he is assigned to the case of a childhood friend, Mickey, who is under investigation for having ties to an infamous mob family.

When Danny learns from Nicky that there’s a deadly new brand of heroin hitting the streets, he begins an all-out manhunt for the distributor. Meanwhile, Frank pulls out all the stops to assist in getting the drugs off the street.

Danny and Baez must track down a Marine veteran who Danny thinks is suffering from PTSD. Meanwhile, Frank is caught off-guard during a press conference by a woman who is seeking justice for her murdered daughter.
Danny and Baez investigate the murder of Tiffany Lamp, a popular drag queen from a reality television show who was found murdered in a local park.
When Danny and Baez investigate the kidnapping of a young girl who disappeared after school, it brings back difficult memories for Danny, who worked on a similar unsolved case many years ago.
When Danny takes a call from a woman who is threatening to kill herself along with the man who killed her parents in a drunk driving accident, he rushes to find her.

Danny and Baez investigate when an expectant mother is a victim of a 'knockout game,' in which teenagers punch unsuspecting civilians in the head. Meanwhile, Frank wrestles with promoting an officer when he thinks it can be viewed as favoritism.

Danny and Baez investigate the death of a woman whose body was dumped after she was killed by a lethal dose of lidocaine following secret plastic surgery. Meanwhile, Frank privately assigns Jamie a cold case and Erin tries out speed dating.
Danny and Baez investigate the murder of a respected college professor who was involved with a questionable scholarship program.

When Erin is assigned to investigate a case in which an on-duty police officer is accused of killing a suspect already in custody, Frank urges her to stick to the facts to avoid a publicity scandal for the NYPD.
When a detective from Danny’s precinct is killed while working undercover, Frank puts on a full-court press to find his killer, only to discover that the deceased had a big secret.
When Danny is placed on modified duty after investigating a case that was off-limits, he realizes he stumbled upon something that someone is trying to keep quiet.
As Danny and Baez escort confiscated drugs to a remote location for incineration, their convoy is attacked and Baez is seriously injured, leaving Danny to track down the drug cartel responsible.
The peaceful world of a Ponderosa hand is disturbed by the arrival of his no-good father and twin brother, who is a wanted man.
The new stranger in town claims to be the famous pirate Jean Lafitte, and Hoss believes him.

Sam Logan is released from jail after serving his twenty year sentence for stealing $100,000 worth of gold dust.  He is followed by a bounty hunter who believes Sam will lead him to where the gold is buried.
An author is inspired to write about the heroic Cartwrights after watching first-hand as they fight off an attempted robbery of a stage.
A Mormon with two wives is badgered by the town's people and then things get much worse.
As the persecuted party awaits Ben and Hoss' return, Herber is shot and killed. Joe retaliates and shoots Herber's assassin.
A man who looks similar to Joe uses Joe's name and gets Joe in the position of facing the firing squad.
In what is arguably the best comedy of the series, Hoss swears he has seen green elves running around the Ponderosa and a smooth-talking Irishman complicates matters even worse.
Outlaws capture Ben and hide him in an abandoned mine, holding him for a ransom.  The boys must come up with a plan to save him before it's too late.

In this sequel to "The Waiting Game", Laura resents Adam's advice on how she ought to be running her ranch.  A newcomer, Ward Bannister, comes to her aid, but is actually part of a scheme to steal her ranch.
First Ben's sons are making lots of noise, so he goes into town to sleep in the hotel. Then, various noises and things interrupt Ben's sleep.  Will he ever get his desired good night's rest?
One of Joe's old girlfriends thinks he killed her husband so they could come together.  Unfortunately, that is what her husband's twin brother also believes.
Hoss is seriously injured internally and Ben seeks help from the only doctor within 50 miles, who happens to be in prison for murder.
After a triumphant tour in Europe, a famous Negro singer encounters racial prejudice in Virginia City when he arrives for a concert.
Adam and Laura are finally engaged.  Adam is secretly building a house and planning for the future. Laura realizes that it's Will she is in love with.
In this series' highlight, little Michael Thorpe heads to the high country to ask God to spare his critically wounded father, believing he has found Him in the form of longtime fugitive Tom Cain.
Will is having second thoughts about staying on at the Ponderosa, and outlaws hit the ranch and take him with them.
Boruto makes a desperate decision to prevent Momoshiki from taking over his consciousness again.
Boruto Uzumaki, the son of the village leader, saves a boy named Denki Kaminarimon, who's being picked on by bullies.
After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time.
After getting caught in a fight between Metal and Shikadai, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

programmes.st: A Ninjutsu Battle of the Sexes!
programmes.d: At the suggestion of Shino Aburame, their homeroom teacher, Boruto and his classmates split off into gendered teams to capture flags placed on the roof.
A mysterious student named Mitsuki has transferred into Boruto's class from Hidden Sound Village.
Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki notice their teacher is acting different than he usually does, and Shino suddenly attacks them!
Cho-Cho's scared because she thinks she's being watched by someone, so she decides to catch them in the act.
A Visual Jutsu places Boruto within a dream, and afterward, Boruto declares the dream has awakened his Byakugan, the Kekkei Genkai unique to his mother's Hyuga Clan.
Under his father and grandfather's guidance, Boruto spars with his aunt Hanabi. No matter how hard he tries, he can’t activate his Byakugan in any form.

programmes.st: The Ghost Incident: The Investigation Begins!
programmes.d: Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow "The Ghost" and is excited when he and his friends Shikadai and Mitsuki decide to solve the recent "Ghost Incidents."
During a tour of workplaces for their school assignment, Sumire, Wasabi Izuno and Namida Suzumeno get wrapped up in the Ghost Incident and are hurt.
The Ghost incidents suddenly come to an end and Boruto and his classmates are puzzled, but Mitsuki seems to know something they don't.
Seventh Hokage Naruto and his top advisors are shocked to learn who the perpetrator is from the results of Sai's investigation. Just then, Nue, an enormous otherworldly beast, appears!

programmes.st: The Path That Boruto Can See
programmes.d: The late Danzo Shimura was the founder and leader of the Foundation, an elite branch of the ANBU Black Ops. The recent incidents have been masterminded by someone who had sworn to carry on Danzo's wishes.
The ghost incident that threatened the Hidden Leaf Village is over, and now Boruto is unable to awaken the mysterious power he used.
Exam day is fast approaching, and everyone at the Academy begins preparing for them. Repeating a grade is a possibility if you fail a test.
Sarada agrees to return a teddy bear to a young patient at the hospital, but she forgets it on the train and goes into a panic.

programmes.st: A Day in The Life of the Uzumaki Family
programmes.d: The Uzumaki household is thrown into chaos when Himawari, Boruto's younger sister, catches a cold.

Boruto pulls a prank and is pursued around the village by Naruto. Seeing this, Sarada can't help but be exasperated, but a part of her grows wistful as she thinks of her father, Sasuke, whom she hasn't seen since she was a baby.
Sarada, who has doubts about who her real mother is, joins Cho-Cho, who is about to set out on a journey to find her ¿real parents?
Sarada arrives at the tower where her father is, only to be hurt by Sasuke's surprising words and actions.
Sarada is in shock after Sakura is captured by Shin's jutsu. Even Naruto, with his exceptional tracking skills, is unable to locate her.
Determined to rescue Sakura, Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto, and Cho-Cho.
The Hidden Leaf Village is filled with excitement upon the arrival of the Kage for the Five Kage Summit.
Boruto and his classmates head to the Village Hidden in the Mist in the Land of Water for a field trip.
Boruto and his classmates are invited to tour the Hidden Mist Academy under Kagura and Chojuro's escort.
Tsurushi Hachiya, Kagura's former classmate at the Academy, finds Boruto and his friends from the Leaf irritating, so he kidnaps Denki.
Kagura unwittingly becomes part of a plot set up by Shizuma Hoshigaki, a man who opposes the new, peaceful shinobi order.
The New Seven Ninja Swordsmen begin an insurrection, the end goal being to turn their village back into the Blood Mist Village!

programmes.st: The Sharingan vs. The Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang!
programmes.d: Sarada is forced into one-on-one combat with a kunoichi, Buntan Kurosuki, who wields the Lightning Blade, Kiba the Fang! In the thick fog, Sarada uses her Sharingan, but her enemy is stronger than expected
Boruto urges his friend Kagura to return with him, but Kagura rejects him and begins to attack.
The field trip comes to an end, and Boruto and his friends prepare to return to Hidden Leaf. Chojuro, the Mizukage, sees them off, but Kagura is nowhere to be seen.

programmes.d: Three old ladies summon the demon of vanity Kryto and promise to resurrect him, exchanging for health, beauty, and youth for the senior trio.
When the Demon of Illusion threatens Prue and Phoebe at their home, the sisters chase him and he hides in a movie theater.
While studying for the finals in the library, Phoebe meets Charlene, who is researching about demons for her thesis.

Dr. Curtis Williamson, who treated the fever of Piper, unsuccessfully insists in calling her for follow-up exams in the hospital. Actually he is researching the blood of the Halliweel sisters in three monkeys.
San Francisco is in a chaotic situation, with riots everywhere. Piper and Leo find a mysterious man in the middle of the confusion, who vanishes when they chase him.
Sam reunites with his lost love and ends up falling for her daughter!

programmes.st: Bar Wars II: The Woodman Strikes Back
programmes.d: Sam and the Cheers gang lie, cheat and steal to win a drink-making contest.
Rebecca panics when her boss's dog runs away while in her care.
Cliff and his new co-worker fall for each other and put their jobs at risk.
Woody falls for the beautiful daughter of a wealthy Cheers executive.
Carla feels left out when her son spends time with Frasier and Lilith.
Rebecca's on a mission to prove her worth to the corporation.
Soon to be a father, Frasier, takes a retreat to become one with nature.
Sam and Rebecca are dressed-up for the USS Constitution tour, but their respective dates cancel.
Sam makes a move for a sex therapist, but gets turned down cold.
Woody can't live up to the gift-giving expectations for his girlfriend's birthday.
Carla questions her marriage when Eddie is a no-show on their anniversary.
Rebecca and her estranged sister teach Sam a humiliating lesson.
Frasier's colleague visits Boston and makes an enemy out of Rebecca.
Sam almost gets his chance at a date with Rebecca, until a handsome corporate raider steps in.
Rebecca takes a trip to Beverly Hills with Robin on his Lear jet.
Sam considers opening a bar of his own to give his life purpose.
When Cliff accepts his girlfriend's marriage proposal, his fear of commitment turns him into a wreck.
While Sam regrets the hasty sale of his Corvette, Norm learns that being the boss is harder than it looks.
Sam, Carla and Norm set sail in Robin Colcord's boat, only to discover there's a live bomb on board.
While the bar's patrons and management celebrate Cheers' 100-year anniversary, Lilith gives birth to a baby boy.

programmes.st: Death Takes A Holiday On Ice

Frasier kidnaps his own son to keep him from being ritually circumcised in the Jewish tradition.
The guys at Cheers have a beard-growing contest to test their manhood.
When Rebecca's plan to surprise Robin Colcord with a romantic evening backfires, she ends up trapped in Robin's penthouse with Sam.
While Norm's ex-secretary falls for Cliff, Rebecca searches for "hidden treasure" in a gift from Robin.
Rebecca's favorite college professor comes to visit, and much to her disbelief, has a brief affair with Sam.
Cliff gets hauled off the stage when he's a contestant on Jeopardy.
Rebecca finds out that she's not the only woman in Robin's love life.
Rebecca finds out that she's not the only woman in Robin's love life.
Woody's girlfriend's mother, a beautiful older woman, makes sexual advances toward him.
Frasier is upset when Lilith's new book labels him a boring, dependable "good boy."

programmes.st: Indoor Fun With Sammy And Robby
programmes.d: Rebecca's plans for a romantic day with Robin are ruined when he opts to spend the day in a game of one-upmanship with Sam.
Pro and amateur bakers must use hot peppers to create spicy cupcakes.
The bakers attempt to combine classic brownies with aromatic ginger.
Bakers and fakers must use beer in their chocolate chip cookie creations.
The bakers cobble together a gooey treat by using cheese in fruit cobblers.
Pro and amateur bakers find creative ways to use hard candies and cereal.
Contestants combine coffee and lemon bars before taking on pretzels.
Contestants race to creatively combine doughnuts with potato chips.
Contestants battle it out by creatively combining cheesecake with popcorn.
Pro and amateur bakers face off in a fruit tart battle with pistachios.
The bakers are challenged to use beans in campfire classic s'mores.
Competitors are challenged by carrot cake with lime and pickle desserts.
Contestants make whoopie pie with potatoes and sweeten up an onion.
The bakers try not to crumble when using mangoes in their coffee cakes.
The bakers must feature a cornucopia of corn options in their apple pies.
The bakers have to incorporate soy options in the banana bread challenge.
Great ideas erupt during the lava cake challenge involving lavender.
Bakers and fakers face spiced cream puffs and tea-infused sweets.
Bakers and fakers must make wine in upside-down cakes work in their favor.
Challenges with beet parfaits and grapes sort the bakers from the fakers.
Contestants either take a pie to the face or create an elegant dessert.

The guys build a drive-through double corn crib as an entrance.
The guys get creative and sell their scraps as upcycled products.
The guys use three centuries of materials to create a custom pavilion.
The guys reclaim a double-pen barn, and Mark visits a finished lodge.
The team visits Pennsylvania to disassemble a 150-year-old carriage house.
The guys stop in Paducah, KY, to save a little cabin in a big quarry.
The guys reconfigure logs from the Bird's-Eye Barn into a fishing cabin.
Mark restores the barnwood from a bank barn for his client's restaurant.
The team builds a log cabin craft store for a West Virginia family.
Mark and the guys take beams from a massive barn in Schuylkill County, PA.
Old wood meets new as the guys build an antique log cabin in a modern home.
The Barnwood Builders unwrap a giant tobacco barn with logs hidden inside.
Mark and the guys build a cabin using barn beams instead of logs.
Mark and the guys help their neighbor rebuild after a devastating flood.
The crew saves a family's log home in Leivasy, West Virginia.
Mark challenges his crew to build an old-fashioned fort using spare logs.
The crew transforms an office space into a showroom for their business.
An old project finds a home in Texas to match a client's favorite painting.

programmes.d: Mark and the guys rebuild a log home lost in the Gatlinburg, TN, wildfires.
A millionaire offers $10,000 to five people who agree to be locked in a large, spooky, rented house overnight with him and his wife.

Master of the Midnight Movie Vincent Price plays the sole survivor of a plague that has transformed all humans into vampire-like zombies. He battles them nightly, until, desperately lonely and at the end of his rope...he makes a startling discovery!

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger (who won a Best Actor Oscar® for his performance) shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay. Lee Grant and Warren Oates also star.

A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

Aerialist Burt Lancaster--who retired after suffering an injury--agrees to train aspiring trapeze artist Tony Curtis. But when both men fall in love with the beautiful and ambitious Gina Lollobrigida, the triangle threaten the dreams of them all.

Charlton Heston stars as Brad Braden, the circus manager who lives and breathes to keep the show rolling. With the Big Top about to hit rock bottom, Braden hires The Great Sebastian, a daring trapeze legend, to revitalize the circus.
Tony Curtis gives a winning performance as the great Houdini, the struggling circus performer who emerged as the world’s most captivating magician and escape artist.

Love arrives with a splash when a handsome and eligible tycoon and a beautiful working woman meet over a curbside mud puddle. He’s enchanted by her small town ways, she’s captivated by his romantic, debonair manner.
A pretty girl has John in a whirl, and his determination to meet her prompts the taxi gang to come up with a surefire line that would unfreeze any woman on earth in Taxi.
Elaine fears the worst when the cabbies invite themselves to her party for her highbrow art world friends who have no clue that she moonlights as a cab driver.
The high-spirited taxi gang helps a jittery Bobby fight potential disappointment when he decides that he will end his stage career if he doesn’t get an acting job before midnight.
Mechanic Latka Gravas faces deportation unless he marries a U.S. citizen. The taxi gang comes to his rescue by pitching in and hiring a local working girl to be his bride.
John and his new wife, Suzanne, reach a crisis point in their marriage when one of them must drop out of college due to financial woes.
Chip sees a ghost while trick-or-treating.
All of the Douglases fall in love at the same time.
Chip has no mother to provide a recipe for a contest.
Chip tries to join a club of older schoolmates.
Robbie must somehow go on a date and write a history paper in one weekend.
A paper drive sparks tempers between Chip and a friend.
Mike must judge his girlfriend in a beauty contest.
Steve seeks a particular doctor for his ailing back.
Robbie's girlfriend has an attractive, single mother.
Chip mopes over being motherless.

Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it The Thing.

The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

Green Acres is greener than ever…with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fiancé stood him up at the alter on their big day.

Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programmes.st: Home Is Where You Run Away From
programmes.d: Lisa's dreams come true, and so do Oliver's nightmares, when Eb discovers a runaway boy sleeping in the hay in their barn. Lisa is only too excited about the idea of having the sounds of platters of little feet around the house.

Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.
When Maude and Vivian go back to college for their thirty-year reunion, Vivian wants to go back in time and do it all over again -- this time without her husband Arthur.
When Carol's beguiling ex-husband suddenly turns on the charm and captivates the Findlay household, Maude and Carol are astounded to discover his motives.
Arthur is determined to teach his visiting grandson the important things in life, but it's the guilty grandpa who learns the most valuable lesson of all.

When Victoria Butterfield's self-righteous father comes to take her away from the 'permissive' Findlay household, Maude confronts him with his less-than-honorable secret. Roscoe Lee Browne returns in the guest star role of Mr. Butterfield.
Maude's grandson Phillip is devastated when he finally finds out the real reason why an 'older woman' has been dating him.

Maude plans a dinner party for her friend, U.S. Congresswoman MacIlhaney, and then plans a new job as her assistant. But Maude could never plan on what's yet to come in the first episode of a three-part story.
Maude mourns the moving of her dearest friends the Harmons until the death of someone close has a drastic effect on her mood...and her life...on the second of a three-part episode.
Sparks start flying when the newly appointed U.S. Congresswoman Maude Findlay arrives in Washington D.C., throwing a monkey wrench into the political machinery by insisting upon doing things her way.

programmes.st: To Denise, with Love and Murder
programmes.d: A murdered mistress and a missing wife bring Barnaby Jones onto the case. The problem? Two weeks have passed, and the killer has covered his tracks.

programmes.st: A Little Glory, a Little Death
programmes.d: Barnaby investigates the death of a woman who was killed in a car accident after the woman's daughter claims that it was no accident. An aging movie star with something to hide is Barnaby's number one suspect.

Barnaby investigates the theft of a million dollar necklace and the murder of the butler who unwittingly walked in on the thief. The leading suspect is a retired jewel thief with a rock solid alibi-he was on TV at the time of the theft.
A retired hit man returns to San Francisco, not knowing that he will be the target of a hit.
A murder brings to light a coin dealer's plan to substitute fakes for the rare coins in a collection.
One witness in a racketeering trial is killed with a booby-trapped car, and Stone worries that the remaining witness, Roy Chaffee, will be picked off by a hit man if he surfaces.
Stone discovers that a murdered woman was involved with both a famous newspaper reporter and his son.
A gang takes Mike Stone hostage after killing a policeman in an attempt to flee from a grocery store robbery. They want to trade Stone in for their leader, Buddy Sims.

Three criminals plan to devastate the Hawaiian sugar cane industry by importing a borer moth with no known cure or natural predator. Their goal is to ruin the land, allowing one of them to purchase it at a low price.
A Japanese female terrorist, with American scientists, kidnaps industrialist's son & demands $1.5m ransom. Five-O team races to save boy held in capsule with 52hr air supply before suffocating.

programmes.st: Love Thy Neighbor - Take his Wife
programmes.d: Steve McGarrett and Five-O are on a mission to find the kidnapper of a wealthy land developer's wife. Despite evidence pointing to militant ecologist Ben Tanaka, McGarrett has doubts and continues to investigate to uncover the true culprit.

Trying to identify and bag the burglars who have been heisting a fortune in gold stored
at various dental-supply warehouses, McGarrett sends an undercover agent into a
rehabilitation institution for delinquent youths in hopes of securing a lead.

Operating with daring, and virtually under the nose of Five-O Chief Steve McGarrett, Hawaiian history museum curator Arthur Lambert secretly plots to turn criminal and stage the biggest bank robbery in Island annals.

Honolulu prostitutes are being murdered, and those who have not been are living in terror. McGarrett feels sure the murderer's game is extortion — a demand accompanied by a death threat which is carried out if the demand is not met.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.st: Home Is Where The Heart Is
programmes.d: A conservative minister is murdered while trying to close down a traveling bordello operating near his church, but a surprising side of the man is revealed when the Sparta police investigate his death and, later, his wife's. Diane Ladd guest stars.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: After an employee of the high school is a no-show for work, it is discovered her car was run off the road by the driver of a semi-truck, resulting in her death. Later, the prime suspect, her ex-husband, is also murdered. Who wanted them both dead?

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: After her involvement in a crime committed in Philadelphia, Regina, an old friend of Althea's runs to Sparta. She stays with Althea and sparks fly with Officer Sweet, but her past catches up when a dead body is found, and it's connected to her.
A pilot of an airliner carrying Dr. Sloan and Amanda to a medical conference in Europe is murdered.
A wealthy woman and her lover concoct an elaborate scheme to do in her husband.
A comedian (Tim Conway) makes a bumbling attempt to do in his more successful former partner (Harvey Korman)---whose wife turns up dead.
A mad bomber whom Dr. Sloan helped put away has escaped and wants the good doctor blown away.

The skeletal remains of a teenage Native American boy are found on a construction site. The boy was murdered eight years earlier. Walker feels the spirit of the Native American who helps him solve the mystery of his death.

A group of cops execute criminals that beat the justice system. After a few murders, the Rangers figure out the pattern and try to track down the bad cops. When an innocent person is killed, Walker makes it his job to stop the group.

An agricultural company produces cattle feed that contains a virus. Instead of recalling the feed, they let the virus spread for research and a way to make it better. The virus affects almost everyone in town.

Alex is about to prosecute a man named Karl Mayes. She learns that he hired her father to defend him. Alex's father is a recovering alcoholic and Mayes gets him to drink. Eventually, he's not sure if he can defend Mayes.

An investigation into the theft of a state-of-the-art military helicopter for use in the drug trade leads Walker to a former fellow Marine Corps officer, who abandoned his unit 25 years ago in Vietnam.
Trapped inside the Phoenix Foundation by a group of terrorists, MacGyver races against a ticking bomb to save his life and that of his grandfather's.
MacGyver is the Thorntons only hope when they are taken hostage in the swamps of Louisiana by an ex-agent seeking revenge.
MacGyver uncovers an assassination plot against an informer threatening to expose a drug trafficking network.
MacGyver battles ex-cons to save the life of a woman and her unborn child.
Steve becomes embroiled in political intrigue after the murder of a city councilman's wife appears to be part of a larger political strategy.
Mark investigates when her older lover, a new state Supreme Court Justice, murders a teenage girl.

A Malibu Hills fire is the backdrop for rising tensions between the residents; a disgraced stockbroker, a naturalist, a worried father, and a land developer. A worried Dr. Sloan deals with his own parental fears when Steve helps fight the fire.

Community General is already under increased security, with a high-profile criminal hospitalized, when an important businesswoman is brought in. Mark suspects her security guard has deadly intentions.

programmes.st: Didja Ever Have One of Those Days?
programmes.d: Steve has a terrible day.
Robbie makes a deal to get a car and win the girl.
Mike announces that he has found his true love: Sally Ann Morrison.
Chip and his new pal Ernie go treasure hunting.
Chip and Ernie conclude that the world is ending.
Bub tries to cover his baldness to impress a woman.
When Dennis has no one to play with, he decides to walk to his Grandfather’s house, which is miles away!
Dennis and Tommy try to sell Valentine’s Day cards in July to buy swim fins.
Dennis becomes fast friends with a girl from Hong Kong who is staying with the Wilsons.
Dennis hears the Wilsons arguing and spreads the news around the neighborhood, leading  some of the neighbors to think the Wilsons have split up.
Mrs. Elkins turns Dennis down for a job delivering circulars for her campaign, but Mr. Wilson agrees to help Dennis pursue it.
Following a complaint from Mrs. Elkins, Sgt. Mooney takes Mr. Wilson to court for an alleged violation of a town ordinance when his incinerator continues to burn after 8:00 a.m.

When Mr. Wilson's money is lost at Quigley's market through a hole in his pocket, he cannot pay Dennis for washing his car - but Dennis misinterprets "the market" to mean stock and assumes Mr. Wilson is broke.
Mr. Wilson's article about gypsies is returned with the request that he get to know them better through further research.

Peter has a crush on Jan's new friend but every plan to impress her backfires. Inspired by "Cyrano de Bergerac", he launches a final plan to win her over with Greg's help but it also backfires when she falls for Greg instead.

The boys try to spook the girls in the middle of the night with a ghost, so they try to get revenge by giving them a taste of their own medicine. But after Alice criticizes them for being so scared, the kids collectively have a new target.

Jan feels disrespected and ignored by her brothers and sisters, so she tells everyone that she wishes she was an only child. Meanwhile, Carol and Alice have a competition over who can cook the best strawberry preserves.

Mike thinks Greg wants to be an architect after reading Greg's school essay, but Greg doesn't want to hurt Mike's feelings and tell him the truth. Meanwhile, the other Brady kids also begin thinking about their future careers.

The kids give Alice the cold shoulder after they think she has broken their trust, so Alice decides to leave her job as housekeeper. However, the kids soon regret the decision after the new housekeeper teaches them a lesson.
Marcia thinks that a girl who is suddenly interested in Greg is actually using him so that Greg will vote for her as head cheerleader--over Marcia.

Peter tries out for the role of George Washington in a school play, but gets the role of Benedict Arnold instead. But he then wants to quit the play altogether when his classmates start branding him as a "traitor."
Marcia has a crush on her new dentist, which only intensifies when she mistakes an opportunity to babysit for him as a date with him to the ballet.

Bobby doesn't want to be safety monitor for his class because his classmates now hate him. However, he soon abuses his power and begins reporting on his family when they break house rules. Meanwhile, the family salvages an old sailboat.
Bobby becomes obsessed with Jesse James. Mike and Carol don't approve of his new hero, and try to find a way to convince him that James was nothing but a "mean, dirty killer."
Marcia breaks a date with Charlie when "big man on campus" Doug Simpson asks her out. However, after she gets hit in the nose with a football, Doug Simpson breaks his date with her.

Peter gets a job at the bike shop, but he is fired after three days. He doesn't want to tell his parents the bad news, because he told the family he might be getting a promotion to salesman the day he got fired.

Naomi comes over and announces that she has sold her home and is going to move away. After drinking and celebrating, they return to Mama's, and Naomi ends up spending the night. Vint ends up asking Naomi to marry him.
Naomi and Vint's wedding is coming up.  While the women are having a little party, Ellen is worried that her husband Bruce is having an affair, and the family tries to tell her that he is not.

The day of the wedding has come, and Mama is under a lot of stress trying to clean the house for the ceremony. She gives Vint her late husband's sapphire ring and tells him to not let Eunice know because she wants it.

Vint tells the family about his plan on taking Mama, Ellen, Naomi, and Buzz with him to play Family Feud. Mama is against going, but Vint tells her they need her because she is an important factor, being the "sweet old lady."

Eunice is given a surprise birthday party at the Bigger Jigger. The party soon takes a nasty turn, and Mama and Eunice get into a fight. They get arrested after accidentally hitting two police officers and have to share a cell.
Though Mama doesn't have experience, she lands a job as a receptionist. She is fired because of constant distractions from her family whose problems she solves quickly once she returns home.

Buzz and Sonja are getting ready for Homecoming, and Vint tells Sonja she has to be home early because she is a girl. When an angry Sonja returns home late, she and Mama have a talk, and Mama defends her rights as a woman.

programmes.t: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven & Glazunov
programmes.d: Nikolay Lugansky presents works by Rachmaninoff as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov.

programmes.t: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programmes.d: Following the life of Clara Schumann, wife of the composer Robert Schumann, revealing her personality from different angles with testimonies from those who knew her, performers of her music and her biographers.

programmes.t: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programmes.d: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005).

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programmes.st: Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.
Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna from Vienna's Café Sperl; the ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic.
Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.
Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.
Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhausorchester; recorded in Leipzig's Gewandhaus.

In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.
March 1984. Jack Kennedy discovers his daughters brutally murdered. Their mother and niece spend their lives keeping the case alive. DNA leads nowhere. 30 years later, an informant gives up a name.

New DNA technology and the national DNA databank help police hunt down a rapist-killer 11 years after he committed his crimes, and a detective's painstaking recreation of a woman's shooting death proves it wasn't an accident.

A killer authors a book about his con-man past that becomes the key to solving a 29-year-old cold case of two high school sweethearts--and three other cold case murders--leading police to believe he could be the Zodiac Killer.
In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Oklahoma. DNA points to her killer over a decade later and leads investigators across state lines.

Guns found dumped in a pond help police to solve the 15-year-old murder of Detroit cab company owner. And the rape and murder of an Atlanta TV station receptionist goes cold for 20 years before DNA links a man to the crime.
In the heart of Cajun country, young mother Brenda DuPont is found murdered in her home in May 1988. The initial investigation sputters and turns cold, but her sister Linda vows to solve her murder.

After 19 years, Kansas detectives reopen the case of a banker found beaten to death in his bed--and the chief suspect is his cheating wife. And a man with a guilty conscience helps Arkansas police to crack a cold case of murder.
Bill Kurtis examines one of the most infamous cold cases in Los Angeles history.

Looks at how law enforcers stick with cases for many years, using fresh evidence to win convictions or to free prisoners who were wrongfully jailed. We examine the unsolved murder of Hogan's Heroes star Bob Crane.

In June 1985, a 20-year-old "Sucker Day" Festival Queen is found brutalized. The small community of Nixa, Missouri, is certain her blood is on the hands of a local wealthy businessman, but after 25 years DNA reveals the true killer.

In 1983, Navy seamen Sonny Grotton left base for a long weekend at home. But as he pulled into his driveway, a gunman killed him. And in 1993, former state trooper Doug Wright claimed his estranged wife shot and killed herself in their home.

When Sherry Leighty goes missing in 1999, her family is left wondering how a dedicated mother of three could vanish without a trace. A decade later, the cold case heats up when Sherry's sister launches a social media campaign.

13 days after Pam Pitts disappears in 1988 her charred body is found at a popular hangout spot in the Arizona desert. When a second victim is discovered in a mineshaft, detectives suspect the killer may have known them both.

programmes.st: The Widow And The Wolf/Texas Drifter
programmes.d: After the murder of her aunt goes cold, a woman helps launch an advocate group that brings awareness to cases that have gone unsolved.

A high school janitor is suspected in the murder of a young girl, but with only circumstantial evidence to go on, police must let the case go cold. And a woman asks the police to reopen the 24-year-old case of her cousin's disappearance.

From England to Texas to Georgia, I.R. will go inside cold case units and watch as police use ballistics testing, old fashioned fingerprints and a new DNA data bank for criminals, to crack open the mysteries of unsolved crimes.

Drunk History investigates Agatha Christie's disappearance, the anonymous letter writer who terrorized Circleville and the mastermind behind America's only unsolved airplane hijacking, with Kirsten Dunst, Vanessa Bayer and Taran Killam.

programmes.st: Are You Afraid of the Drunk?
programmes.d: Will Ferrell and Seth Rogen star in this episode about how teenage writer Mary Shelley created her legendary novel, "Frankenstein."
John Muir convinces Teddy Roosevelt to preserve Yosemite, journalist Marjory Stoneman Douglas fights to protect the Everglades, and Native American activists occupy Alcatraz.
Moses Fleetwood Walker faces racism in the 19th-century MLB, the Chicago White Sox throw the World Series, and the Callaghan sisters inspire the film "A League of Their Own."
The guys engage in a Mario Kart-style race to determine who will lay claim to a free massage chair.

programmes.st: The One Where the Guys Play Basketball and Do the "Friends" Title Thing
programmes.d: The guys are divided over how far they're willing to go to win an office basketball tournament.
The guys have a huge fight while at dinner to commemorate seven years of living together and spend a miserable night apart from one another.
Ders is forced to revisit a traumatic event from his youth when Adam and Blake convince him to attend a reunion of his high school swim team.
After agreeing to hand off a mysterious package for Karl, the guys stage an office-wide ditch day so that they can stay home and make the deal.
In order to raise enough money for their rent, the guys create a public access wrestling show.
When the guys head to the North Rancho College Job Fair on business, Ders feuds with Coast Guard officers while Adam and Blake pursue their dreams elsewhere on campus.
The TelAmeriCorp employees become fiercely competitive during an office blood drive.
Adam and his rambunctious father hijack Gramps DeMamp's funeral.

Jesse witnesses a car accident and rushes to help the beautiful victim, Chloe Marsden, who has stopped breathing. After a quick application of CPR, Chloe is revived and finds Jesse accompanying her to the hospital.

To Steve, Jesse, and Amanda's embarrassment, Dr. Sloan rehearses with a swing band at BBQ Bob's as he prepares for a benefit dance for the children's unit at the hospital. But the mood quickly transforms into a tone of horror.
Steve meets up with his young protégé, Tommy Allen, but is ready to strangle him when he finds out that Tommy was involved in another brawl, this time at BBQ Bob's!
Scaroth intends to travel back in time to save his own people from destruction.
While under the influence of the evil Mara, Tegan redirects the Tardis to the Mara's former home planet.
The Doctor begins to unravel the legend of the Little Mind's Eye crystal; Tegan remains under the Mara's control as it attempts to regain its hold over the planet Manussa.
Chela takes the Doctor's fears seriously and tells him the snake dancer Dojjen can aid him in defeating the Mara.
The Doctor and the original snake dancer Dojjen work to rid the planet of the malign Mara once and for all, but it has the whole of Manussa in its psychic grip now.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part One
programmes.d: The Doctor and Romana follow a distress signal to the jungle world of Chloris.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part Two
programmes.d: The Doctor escapes Adrasta by going into the mine, but there's something lurking inside.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part Three
programmes.d: The Doctor makes contact with the creature and realizes that all is not as it seems.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part Four
programmes.d: The truth of Adrasta's scheme is revealed, but a terrible retribution is already in motion.
(1/4) A hyperspace accident results in two ships fusing together and releasing a deadly menace.
(2/4) The Doctor and Romana discover that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.
(3/4) The Mandrels have escaped from the Eden projection and are attacking the passengers.
(4/4) Unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.
