programmes.d: With the TARDIS disabled, the Doctor is powerless to act when Romana is kidnapped.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part Two
programmes.d: The Doctor attempts to repair the TARDIS so that he can come to Romana's rescue.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part Three
programmes.d: The Doctor and Romana suspect that the Nimon are a small part of a large invasion.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part Four
programmes.d: On Crinoth, Romana discovers the truth behind the Nimon's empty promises.
When an old mysterious book enters his life, everything changes for young Chris Parsons.
The Doctor and Romana visit the Leisure Hive, a tourist attraction on the planet Argolis.
The Doctor and Romana track down the cause of the mysterious deaths at the Leisure Hive.
The Tachyon Recreation Generator ages the Doctor into a white haired old man.
The obsessed Pangol is determined to give Argolis a future and strike back at the Foamasi.
Meglos plans to steal the ancient and powerful Dodecahedron from Tigella.
Posing as the Doctor, Meglos penetrates the underground city of Tigella.
Meglos escapes with the Dodecahedron and the Doctor is mistakenly held responsible.
The Doctor must prevent Meglos from using the dodecahedron to destroy Tigella.
What has become of Gallifrey? Who are the marauding Outlers? What lurks beneath the marsh?
What is the strange journey of the TARDIS? How do the Marshmen make short work of K9?
What is the secret of the Starliner. Why is chaos closing in on the Deciders?
What is the legacy of Dexter's research? How does the Doctor give evolution a small nudge?
The TARDIS lands on a world where the inhabitants live in fear of the Three Who Rule.
A family deals with a stray dog who bites; Daisy Fuentes has trouble controlling her English bulldog.
A dog barks all the time and might pose a threat to children; a beagle mix has lots of strange behaviors.
A herding dog likes to bite the noses of horses; a family struggles with a dog who runs out the door as soon as it is opened.
Cesar helps Lucy, an odd Dalmatian who is affectionate one minute and angry the next and Lizzie who is obsessed with running all the time.
Cesar has his hands full with a Labrador that is obsessed with water and a Chihuahua with a penchant for biting legs.
A human psychologist calls Cesar for help when her pet pug and pet pig fight; an emotionally scarred German shepherd.
An Australian Shepherd behaves aggressively after being attacked by a couple of dogs; a shelter dog won't stop biting and snapping at potential owners.
An aggressive Manchester Terrier; a Wheaton Terrier with poor social skills; a dog who is afraid of the ocean.
Nate Brouwer and Charnae Wright bonded through their love of dogs and the outdoors, but their feuding dogs are threatening to tear them apart.
A dog trained to sniff out contraband cell phones in prisons is unable to do his job due to his skittish nature; a dog is terrified of hot air balloons.
A Dogo Argentino with canine aggression; a terrier/corgi mix who becomes aggressive when faced with traveling.
Mufasa, a South African boerboel, became aggressive after being pinned down by another dog; Tucker, a teacup poodle's behavior became more aggressive.
A couple with three unruly dogs, one with aggression issues; a poodle who fears the back door since running into the screen door; a Weimaraner who is territorial and aggressive.
A dog with an abusive past fears men; a Border Collie mix refuses to leave his chair and is afraid of leashes.
Aggressive bulldog Hugo is sent to canine rehab; Crusty must overcome his dominance issues if he's ever going to enjoy walks.
Two Jack Russell terriers, Ruby and Jinx, show how dogs communicate through energy and body language.
Stella is a bulldog mascot for a dog-friendly café; a German shepherd who barks too loud, and two aggressive miniature pinschers.
At an army base, Cesar helps an Australian shepherd scared of men in uniform and a Shetland shepherd who barks non-stop when planes fly overhead.
Cesar helps two former gang members through Homeboy Industries, an outreach program designed to break the cycle of gang violence but who have problem dogs at home.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
Dora and her friends are super good at hiding, especially Señor Tucán when he hides in the Rain Forest. If we can find all 8 friends, Señor Tucán promises to introduce us to his new baby toucans.

Finding the animals—that's a good trick! If you see an animal, aim and say, "Click!" Dora the photographer and her assistant, Boots, set off with a new camera to take pictures of wild animals for a photo contest.
Dora and Boots are on the hunt for cascarones—special eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

Dora and Boots are Super Spies on a top-secret mission: they have to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes. Spy gadgets—everything from rocket sneakers to a Swiper detector—will help them find their way.
Boots is visiting Dora's classroom when they notice that the school pet, a cute and cuddly hamster named Mimo, is missing from his cage. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to rescue him!
"Happy Birthday to you," plays the Birthday Balloon as it floats by high in the sky. There's going to be a birthday party—but whose birthday is it?

When Dora and Boots color in a picture of Mami Duck and her eggs, their coloring book magically comes to life, and the eggs start to hatch. Suddenly, the wind blows one of Mami Duck's eggs away. Oh no!
Mary had a Little Lamb, but now Little Lamb is lost.  Dora and Boots jump into a big book of Nursery Rhymes to bring Little Lamb back to her best friend, Mary.

Calling all trucks!  Boots sure loves trucks.  When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue.  Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.
What are we going to do?  Cockledoodledoo!  Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun.  Along the way we practice making lots of noise.
Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers, and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.
Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

Woof!  Woof!  Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies."  A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages.  To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou—a cute and cuddly forest creature—who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island.  It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs.  Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.
Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots' favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin!  It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Ping³ino all the way back home to the South Pole.
Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!
It's Halloween, and Dora and Boots are out trick-or-treating when a cute monster surprises them. Dora and Boots help hurry it home before the clock strikes 12.
What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?
It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.
Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats, and even silly dancing. But, oh no!
Uh oh! Boots has a hole—un hoyo—in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!
Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.
A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs—from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.
Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind and snow!
Byron Sully, an enigmatic man whose closest companions are the Indians and a wolf, becomes Mike's friend as she struggles for acceptance.
Dr. Quinn immediately takes action to stop the spread of a deadly epidemic.

Mike's stoic, disapproving Bostonian mother, Elizabeth, who, after years of estrangement, visits her daughter in Colorado Springs but finds her unconventional life on the frontier difficult to accept.
When a starving orphaned immigrant takes desperate measures to feed his siblings, the only thing standing between him and a noose is Kid Cole, the new sheriff.
Loren, the unforgiving father-in-law, threatens to take back Sully's homestead.
Michaela worries when Charlotte's husband, Ethan Cooper, comes back to the family he abandoned, convincing almost everyone of his newfound ways.
When the town's water supply is tainted with mercury by a wealthy mining baron, many people become sick and Dr. Mike threatens the miner to clean it up or have his land taken away.
When Doc Eli, a medicine-show man, arrives in town professing to have created the perfect bottled elixir, Mike sets out to call his bluff, especially when her children's health becomes jeopardized.
A wandering cowboy abandons his baby boy and leaves him in Dr. Mike's care.
Progress comes to Colorado Springs, and Sully pays the price.
When Cheyenne medicine man Cloud Dancing is wounded by General Custer, who intends to hang him, Sully and Dr. Mike join forces to help him escape.
As Dr. Mike's birthday approaches, the kids decide to do something about her unmarried status
Matthew and Michaela are at odds over his future when he sets out to prove to others -- and to himself -- that he's a grown man ready to take on life -- and decides to marry Ingrid.
Influenced by the pulp romance novels she loves, Colleen develops her first crush -- on Sully -- and schemes a way for him to rescue her from danger.
Dr. Mike faces the most difficult challenge of her career when she is forced to operate on Brian after he suffers a brain injury.
Dr. Mike discovers Hank's dark secret -- an illegitimate son.

Blake fires the La Mirage manager for withholding crucial information regarding the fire; Alexis offers a reward for the arrest and conviction of the arsonist; Michael Culhane continues to romance Amanda.

Krystle's dizzy spells force her to see a doctor; Jackie remembers seeing the La Mirage blaze start in Claudia's room, proving Blake's innocence; Blake receives a letter from Caress, pleading for his help.

Blake's trip to Caracas to free Caress proves unsuccessful; Dex's proposal of marriage to Alexis is rejected; Blake catches Michael Culhane and Amanda in a passionate embrace and immediately fires the promiscuous chauffeur.

Blake and Dex's plan to free Caress from prison succeeds, as she returns to Denver with a fever for revenge; Sammy Jo is pregnant with Clay's baby and warns Steven no court would deny her custody of Danny.

Caress vows retribution for her years of imprisonment; Michael Culhane uses Zach Powers to acquire thirty percent of "The Crater" project; Sammy Jo tells a distraught Clay of her pregnancy; Caress blackmails Emily Falimont.

Caress continues to extort Emily Fallmont; Clay, suffering from guilt, proposes marriage to Sammy Jo, Las Vega style; Michael is forced to tell Amanda the truth; Emily tells Buck of her past with Ben and fleeing from his rage.

A dying Emily begs Blake to use the letter she wrote to bring an end to Alexis and Ben's treachery; Clay and Sammy Jo are married, Nick Kimball relentlessly pursues Dominique's affections; Blake rejects Michael Culhane's efforts for a reconciliation.
Using Emily's letter, Blake devises a way to regain his empire; Sammy Jo learns she is not pregnant, but keeps it a secret from Clay; fearing Michael Culhane's deceitful intentions.
Alexis relinquishes control of Denver-Carrington and the mansion back to Blake; Ben battles Alexis for equal control of Colbyco; Michael Culhane and Alexis form an alliance against Blake.

Sammy Jo fears she will lose Clay if he learns about her false pregnancy; Adam discovers the identity of the mysterious woman tormenting Ben; An explosion rips through an oil rig, trapping Blake amidst raging flames, as Ben leaves him to die.

Ben returns to Blake's aid and pulls him to safety, both narrowly escaping the devastation of the ensuing explosion; Blake suffers memory loss due to the explosion; Alexis leads Blake to believe they have been married for the past twenty-three years.
Sammy Jo informs Clay of her desire for an annulment to their marriage; Dominique is roughed up by thugs threatening her to cooperate with their boss, as Gary Tilden coincidentally returns to Denver.
Krystle suspects Blake's once passionate feelings for Alexis may still be lingering; Blake and Ben reach a mutual reconciliation; Amanda disappears to London; Leslie Carrington finds Ben.
Clay reluctantly signs the annulment papers to end his and Sammy Jo's marriage; Blake persuades Leslie Carrington to stay in Denver and give Ben a second chance; Adam proposes to Dana.

Krystina lapses into unconsciousness, as doctors fight against time to bring her back; Krystle rebuffs Alexis' sincere concern for Krystina's health; Steven and Sammy Jo assume the appearance of a normal marriage for Danny's sake.
Krystina is flown to California, awaiting a donor for her vital heart transplant; Leslie moves into the Carrington mansion; Blake and Krystle mount a media blitz to plea for a heart donor.
Krystina's only hope for life seems dashed, as the mother of the heart donor retracts her offer to allow the operation; Neil McVane carries out his promise of blackmail.
Nicole, Jess and Antonio investigate the disappearance of a man from the federal witness protection program.
Nicole and Jess investigate the circumstances surrounding a man with a gunshot wound to the head and found in the trunk of a car.
Nicole goes undercover to investigate a dangerous arms-dealer.
Nicole and Jess investigate the circumstances surrounding a man with a gunshot wound to the head and found in the trunk of a car.
Stephanie plays the ultimate trump card with Amara; Bella takes another chance on love, only to wake up to a nightmare; Rondell and Evan are blind-sided.
Stephanie closes in on Evan, Hunter, and Titus; Evan and Rondell are greeted with a blast from their past; Evan and Bella endure the worst nightmare of their lives.
Perla feels the heat; Amara sets a trap; Darcia unveils some life-changing news; Hunter nears the brink of disaster; Stephanie reveals a painful secret.
Stephanie issues an ultimatum; Evan betrays an ally; Amara baits a witness; Damian takes a stand.
Rondell and Evan join forces to save Thelma's Place; an unlikely suspect comes forth as Senior's killer; Amara is taken off guard; Stephen and Hunter release their fury; Perla gets revenge.
Bella becomes overwhelmed; Rondell's puppet master is revealed; Stephanie confronts Stephen and Bella; Lori grows suspicious of Titus.
Stephanie and Amara keep their friends close and enemies closer.
Fish-out-of-water attorneys Amara and Titus Hughes adjust to new personal and professional challenges following their move to Atlanta, namely the ruthless Stephanie Carlisle Lancaster.
Mae preaches beautifully at A Day With Lady Mae as the Bishop fears he may lose Calvary; Grace gets a paternity test with Aaron and works with Jacob to clear their family name.
After the success of her big day, Lady Mae is denied the right to run Calvary despite support from the Bishop; Grace takes over thanks to Connie and joins Harmony & Hope Ministries.

On the first Sunday after Harmony and Hope's installation at Calvary, the Greenleaf family's united front shatters; Grace attempts to lead the church's loyalties back toward the Greenleafs, but a call from Noah brings a long buried secret to light.

While engaging in a power struggle with Phil, Grace walks a tightrope, uncertain of what to do regarding her secret; Bishop discovers something about a rival, making it possible to win back Mae and the church.

While facing her past, Grace gives Phil the opportunity to impress key church leadership; Lady Mae steps in to do damage control in Grace's absence, and she is forced to face Mac's ghost and her own stained reputation.

Bob Whitmore returns to Memphis, Tenn., to remind Grace that he is the one in charge and to encourage her to consider a new idea he has for Calvary; on a mission to uncover what's been going on between Noah and Grace, Charity makes a phone call.

With everyone at odds, the Geckos and the Fullers are forced to watch a performance by Santanico Pandemonium.
A paranormal detective (Christian Slater) slowly unravels mysterious events with deadly results.
Two vigilante brothers try to wipe out Boston's criminal underworld. Willem Dafoe and Norman Reedus star.
Chuck Norris plays a kickboxer hired to help cops after a martial artist starts killing their undercover unit.
Two childhood friends plan to rob an armored-car depository, but an NYPD officer stands in their way.
A former soldier navigating London's criminal underworld seizes the chance to assume a new identity.
Jean-Claude Van Damme plays a time-travel cop stopping a corrupt politician from altering the past.
A man teams up with his military brothers to rescue his fiancée from human traffickers. With Bruce Willis.
The rise and fall of Erik Vasquez, the first American-born drug lord in Mexico.

Monica steps in to help when a teen-age boy catches his father, a teacher, kissing one of his students
Monica sets out to uncover the secret that binds a famous talk show host and her overweight, housebound sister
Monica lends support to a woman who has begun to suspect that her son may actually be guilty of a murder for which he was tried and acquitted
Monica helps a man acknowledge that his son will soon die and that he needs to accept and love his unborn grandson, who is being carried by a surrogate mother
Monica and Tess come to the aid of Russell Greene (Gerald McRaney), an unemployed man who moves his family to the small town of Chicory Creek in search of a job and a better life
Monica must figure out how to stop the generational link of hate and violence that is destroying a family,
Monica becomes an assistant to a child psychologist, who, while attempting to cope with the recent loss of his daughter, is trying to dissuade a patient from believing she hears the voices of angels
Monica takes a job as a teacher’s aide in order to help a man who, after teaching for 20 years, feels that he has had no positive impact on his students’ lives

Monica is assigned to help a competitive, ambitious Secret Service agent realize that being a private hero can be just as rewarding as being a public one -- if not more so
Prejudice comes to Colorado Springs as Dr. Mike and Sully try to help a young Latin-American woman when her husband is killed.
Dr. Mike is faced with the prospect of leaving Colorado Springs when Sully is offered a job surveying the new Yellowstone National Park.
Jake and Preston each want Dr. Mike’s endorsement when they run against one another for mayor -- until she is arrested.
Dr. Mike tries to reunite a father and son before it's too late.
Dr. Mike, Sully and Matthew join forces with a legendary marshal to track down the outlaws who wounded Matthew during a robbery.
Colorado Springs prepares for Thanksgiving, unaware of a deadly approaching storm that could destroy the town.
Dr. Mike, Sully and Brian must deal with the town’s prejudice when a black child tries to attend the all-white school.

On a remote Caribbean island, Army Ranger Joe Armstrong saves an old friend from the clutches of "The Lion," an evil super-criminal who has kidnapped a local scientist and mass-produced an army of mutant Ninja warriors.

Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular American Ninja franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!
The American Ninja burst onto the screen in a fourth round of martial arts Action.
The absorbing martial arts film that exposes Ninjutsu, the lethal, little-known "Art of Invisibility"... which includes the use of hypnotism, explosives, and super-human fighting skills.

Sho Kosugi ("Enter the Ninja") delivers a heart-pounding display of strength, speed and lethal Ninja know-how in this action-packed thriller that takes us back to the good old days of the Kung Fu extravaganza.

Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.
Bruce Lee faces an underground criminal element after members of his family begin disappearing. Now he must break his vow of non-violence to take on the terrifying "Big Boss."

Bruce Lee stars as Chen Zhen, a martial arts protégé who returns to his former school in Shanghai when he learns that his beloved instructor has been murdered. To avenge his master's death, Chen must fight the greatest assassins from a rival school.
Billy Lo, a champion fighter and movie star, fakes his death to escape and then expose the crime syndicate that wants to control him.

Cleo is bullied by Charlotte and runs away to the ocean. With Cleo missing, everyone becomes more and more worried. Lewis discovers what Charlotte has been up to and breaks up with her. He finds Cleo and they kiss.

The full moon rises, and with the planets lining up, it can remove mermaid powers for good. Knowing this, Lewis lures Charlotte to the moon pool but it backfires and Emma, Cleo and Rikki all look set to lose their powers.

programmes.d: Cleo and Rikki face their final year of high school without Emma. They make a new friend in Bella and meet new boy Will – and encounter a strange new force on Mako Island that turns water against them.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Jungle Hunt
programmes.d: Will seeks confirmation of his first experience on Mako Island. Bella volunteers to misdirect his search so he won't find the Moon Pool. The girls and Lewis discover the Moon Pool has changed.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Keep Your Enemies Close
programmes.d: Cleo seeks a new job as an assistant dolphin trainer at the Marine Park. Rikki fires Nate's band from playing at the cafe until she and Bella reach an understanding.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Valentine's Day
programmes.d: Cleo is forced to put Lewis' plans for romance on hold to restrain Kim's out-of-control love life. During this time, Don meets Samantha, a National Parks manager, and they start dating.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Big Ideas
programmes.d: Zane concocts a dirt bike race to publicize the café. When Rikki discovers it's a scam, she and Bella decide to teach him and Nate a lesson. Cleo and Lewis make a major discovery about mixing the waters in the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Secrets and Lies
programmes.d: Bella attempts to start a relationship with Will until she sees he's apparently got another girl. Lewis tests the magic Moon Pool water at school and attracts the attention of their Science teacher.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Happy Families
programmes.d: A problematic family beach picnic leads Don to end his relationship with Samantha, until Cleo encourages him to pursue it. Will's sister, Sophie, competes with Bella for a job at the café and sets her sights on Zane.

Rikki and Bella hide out at Cleo's to protect themselves from a full moon water attack. However, Bella is kidnapped by a water tentacle and taken to Mako Island. Lewis tries to keep Will away from the island so the girls can rescue her.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programmes.d: Cleo defies Lewis' advice and experiments with the magic Moon Pool water. Using her powers, Rikki accidentally gets the water into Cleo's aquarium and all the girls have to rescue Cleo's fish Hector.
Bella's warned to back off from Will as he's on the trail of the girls' mermaid secrets. She gets too close to him and he finally discovers she's a mermaid.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Just a Girl at Heart
programmes.d: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt. Rikki and Cleo have to improvise when the cafe's first corporate function is actually a children's party.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Crime and Punishment
programmes.d: Rikki receives counterfeit money at the café and is held captive by criminals on a boat. Bella and Cleo are forced to reveal the trio's secret to Will, so they can rescue Rikki together.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: To Have and to Hold Back
programmes.st: To Have and to Hold Back
programmes.d: Kim attempts to derail Don and Samantha's wedding. Lewis receives an opportunity to study in America. Cleo realises she's got to let Lewis live his own life and let him go overseas.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mermaid Magic
programmes.d: Will pushes himself too far when Zane challenges him to prove his skills as a free-diver. The girls discover a unique crystal in the rock from the Moon Pool.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Power Play
programmes.d: Sophie uses Bella's idea for a fundraising concert and presents it as her own to Rikki to gain publicity for the café. Cleo's caught in the crossfire with Kim when Samantha moves in and puts her stamp on the Sertori home.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Dark Side
programmes.d: Rikki's frustrated by the water attacks and goes to Mako Island on a full moon to confront the strange force in the Moon Pool. With Cleo and Bella delayed, Will pursues her and discovers she's been affected by the experience.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: A Magnetic Attraction
programmes.d: Cleo's introduced to Ryan, a young geophysicist who's working for Samantha. Rikki doesn't react well to Cleo consulting Ryan about the Mako rock and a fracture begins to appear in the trio.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Into the Light
programmes.d: Rikki fears Ryan's explorations on Mako Island will uncover their secrets but Cleo and Bella discount her concern. She almost goes too far trying to stop Ryan from discovering the crystals in the Moon Pool.

Will competes in the Free-Diving Championships but afterward chooses to break from the sport and shrug off Sophie's influence on his life. Rikki sees Sophie kissing Zane at the event and breaks off their relationship.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Queen for a Day
programmes.d: Zane installs Sophie as head of staff at the café. Bella develops a sneezing allergy that also accidentally triggers her powers. Sophie seizes on the problem and looks to fire Bella and the band.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Jewel Thief
programmes.d: The girls discover the Mako crystals contain immense energy and need to mount a rescue mission when Zane jealously steals one in an effort to gain Rikki's attention.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Mako Masters
programmes.d: The girls sit their final school exams and have to avoid a water attack in public when the full moon rises early. They confront the water force in the Moon Pool and are given a message about Mako Island.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Beach Party
programmes.d: Bella's eager to ask Will to the end of year party until she sees him asking Rikki. A big misunderstanding occurs, which prompts Will to express his true feelings for Bella. Sophie tries to get Zane to change the name of the café.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Too Close for Comfort
programmes.d: Don gets a second job at the Marine Park on the Pirate ship and outshines Cleo, threatening the future of her Dolphin show. Bella and Will find difficulty trying to connect with each others' interests.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: A Date With Destiny
programmes.d: Cleo discovers a comet is causing fish to flee the waters around Mako Island. The girls find a way to restart the message in the Moon Pool and discover the comet will collide with earth.

Sophie and Ryan damage the Moon Pool in their efforts to obtain the rare crystals. The girls improvise and use their own magic to prevent the impact of the comet and a planet wide catastrophe. Rikki, Cleo and Bella graduate with a surprise.
Cleo and Emma meet new girl, Rikki, and find themselves stuck on Mako Island where they are transformed into mermaids. As well as growing tails, the girls find they have powers over water.

Annoying Miss Popularity, Miriam, is having a pool party and the girls want to go. But being around water is risky, especially when Zane tosses Cleo into the pool. Lewis is the only one around to help so he finds out their secret.

Rikki, Emma and Cleo discover that sea turtles are being captured by fishing nets. When Rikki and Emma attempt to rescue the turtles by cutting the nets, it causes the fisherman to think that there is a rogue shark roaming their ocean.

Emma decides that she is not going to have her annual sleepover party due to what has happened to them. But Rikki and Cleo try to convince her otherwise. Meanwhile, Lewis conducts experiments on the girls.

Cleo's sister Kim finds her diary and thinks that Cleo and her friends are 'evil mermaids' and she plans to tell everyone. Meanwhile, Lewis goes to Mako Island to find out more about what happened to the girls.
Tension builds as Mel subjects Niles to social humiliation before granting him a divorce. Finally, he can no longer endure the disrespect, and the situation explodes at a party.

Donny drops the lawsuit against Frasier and Daphne because he's met another woman whom he has decided to marry. Frasier dates his lawyer, Abbey, but accuses her of overcharging him for legal expenses.
Frasier betrays Roz by staying friends with her cheating ex-boyfriend.
Frasier reluctantly co-hosts Seattle's Christmas parade with his radio rival.
Frasier is awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award. Martin, his father, accepts on his behalf because Frasier is off analyzing his own life with his old Harvard mentor, Professor Tewsbury.
Frasier decides that three generations of Crane men should head out to the woods for some family bonding, despite their protests.
Frasier and Niles go back to school to learn about auto mechanics.
Frasier and Niles try to revitalize the career of their boyhood Shakespearean actor/idol, only to learn that he stinks.
Frasier's dating destiny unfolds in a pair of parallel universes.
Niles and Daphne decide to go on a diet. Roz tries a new pheromonal perfume that attracts men. Frasier goes on a date with Eileen, Kenny's wife.
After Niles sinks an impossible half-court shot, Frasier finds him impossible to live with.
Roz puts together a space documentary with Senator John Glenn. Niles learns to fly a kite.
Frasier and Niles press Martin's rich girlfriend to save their bankrupt prep school.

Frasier leaves his wine club to host a new radio feature called "The Wine Corner" and is angered to learn that a resentful Niles, the club's overbearing "corkmaster," has ordered its old members not to participate in the program.
Niles and Daphne "get real" about their romance and their idealized impressions of each other.
Daphne attempts to prove to Niles that she has psychic visions, and Frasier is ego-stricken when he discovers that Roz is having an affair with his mentor.
Frasier runs into an old high school friend and finds that he is attracted to her friend, Claire.
Frasier tutors Lana's son in exchange for a date with Claire. Martin goes to a dog party, and Daphne and Niles have trouble sleeping in the same bed.
Frasier's vacation plans with Claire turn disastrous when Daphne, Niles, and Martin show up at the same resort and Frasier starts dreaming about Lana.

Niles gets jealous of an old flame of Daphne's at the dog park; Frasier teaches Lana about honesty in selling a problematic piece of real estate, and Martin secretly attends the parole hearing of the man who shot him.
Frasier has trouble deciding between two women and ends up losing them both. Niles mistakenly goes to a local beach in the buff.
Troubled by his recent relationship woes, Frasier goes to the country for peace and quiet, but ends up facing the ghosts of failed relationships past.
Daphne is tortured by pangs of jealousy when she learns one of Niles's patients is in love with him. Frasier and Martin go to extreme lengths to catch a cricket hiding in the apartment.
Martin goes back to work as a security guard and reflects on his last day as a cop, when he was shot.

Roz comes face-to-face with her own snobbery when she dates a garbage man. Frasier's plan to convince his co-workers that he isn't an elitist snob backfires when he becomes more popular than he wants.

Frasier's psychological party game brings unpleasant revelations at his Halloween party. Niles dresses as Martin and gets drunk on beer. The children in the apartment building believe that Frasier eats kids' brains.
On their 8th anniversary of living together, Frasier accidentally destroys Martin's recliner. Niles discovers Daphne has no talent for music.
Frasier becomes obsessed with replacing a missing tape in his collection of all 2,000 of his shows.
Blood pressures and spirits rise as an intern becomes the pawn in Frasier and Niles' battle over a wine cellar tour.
Frasier's show has been losing the ratings to a hot new program, Dr. Zach, which has a heavy advertising budget. KACL refuses to match their exposure, so Frasier calls on Bebe to turn the screws.
Martin gets criticized at work and decides to let it go; however, Frasier and Niles can't. They decide to interfere, which leads to a lengthy confinement in a storage room.
The arrival of Daphne's mother derails her plans to move in with Niles. Frasier gets into a war with his upstairs neighbor over a parking spot.

When the world's most beautiful people face danger, former models Derek and Hansel step in to tackle a top-secret mission against the criminal mastermind Mugatu. Get ready for a dangerously sexy adventure where looks truly can kill.

programmes.st: MST3K Shorts: Keeping Clean And Neat
programmes.d: Don't leave the house before watching this indispensable guide to hygiene.
Dejected after a day of unsuccessful crime fighting, Officer Dangle rear-ends a civilian and discovers 60 pounds of marijuana in the first episode of this iconic comedy series.
When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.
Clemmy's degenerate boyfriend Steed surprises everyone when he asks her to marry him.
When the Mayor's kid blows his thumb off with an illegal explosive, the officers are put on the line to rid Reno of contraband fireworks.
The deputies partake in a scavenger hunt to determine who gets to attend the execution of a convicted felon, and Williams gives a suspect a makeover.
Jones enjoys some unexpected perks after being relegated to crossing guard duty, and Dangle's bike is stolen again.
Ders wrestles with his impending mortality when he turns 25.
When Jillian gets put in charge at work, all hell breaks loose.
The guys go on the lam from a security guard in Montez's gated community.
You're cordially invited to the wedding of Karl Hevacheck.
In an attempt to reclaim their machismo, the guys go on a Man Trip.
The guys enlist Adam's obese cousin to get a handicapped parking pass.

programmes.d: The Roast of Charlie Sheen assembles a killer dais of comedians to skewer an entertainment legend. Roast Master Seth MacFarlane presides over roasters Mike Tyson, Jeff Ross, William Shatner, Jon Lovitz, Amy Schumer, and more.

programmes.t: The Comedy Central Roast of David Hasselhoff
programmes.d: The Roast of David Hasselhoff puts the star of "Baywatch" and "Knight Rider" in his place when Roast Master Seth MacFarlane leads a dais that includes Jeff Ross, Pamela Anderson, Whitney Cummings, and more.

programmes.t: The Comedy Central Roast of Bob Saget
programmes.d: During the Roast of Bob Saget, America finds out that daddy doesn't know best. Roast Master John Stamos headlines a family-unfriendly event featuring appearances by Gilbert Gottfried, Jon Lovitz, Norm Macdonald, Cloris Leachman, and more.

programmes.t: The Comedy Central Roast of Pamela Anderson
programmes.d: Roast Master Jimmy Kimmel leads a dais including Tommy Lee, Adam Carolla, Eddie Griffin, Sarah Silverman and Lisa Lampanelli as they sling burns at model and actress Pamela Anderson.

Jon falls for Garfield's veterinarian--who puts Garfield on a diet--and invites her to Thanksgiving dinner.

Garfield and Odie fantasize that they are on a Middle-East mission to retrieve the Banana of Bombay, the symbol of humour to nations around the world.

Melinda Gordon has always had the ability to see and talk to dead people. These earth bound spirits, the ones who have yet to cross over to the other side, seek Melinda's help in communicating with the living and resolving unfinished business.

Melinda helps a boy reassure his mother that his death was not her fault, while also preventing the boy's father from seeking revenge on the man who sold them the broken down car that took part in his death.

When a teenage psychiatric patient, Natalie, escapes, her rebellious ghost twin asks Melinda for help, claiming Natalie doesn't belong in the clinic. Their parents placed her there for believing she can still feel Zoë's presence.
Melinda agrees to help a deceased fiancé communicate with his grieving fiancé and find the man who received his heart donation, in an effort to bring closure so they can both move on.
When Melinda and Andrea are hired to auction off furniture from an inn that was recently sold, Melinda encounters the mischievous ghosts of three young boys who refuse to leave the inn.
A year after a teenage boy, Jason Shields, dies in a freak accident after discovering he was adopted, Melinda must help him find his birth mother before he can crossover.

When a young woman dies following a routine procedure in the operating room, Melinda uncovers the truth that the doctor is secretly suffering from dementia and made a mistake during the women's operation that caused her death.

programmes.st: On the Wings of a Dove
programmes.d: When Jim starts behaving uncharacteristically, Melinda learns Jim is being haunted by the ghost of an ex-con, Julian Borgia, who has been attached to Jim ever since Jim was unable to save Julian's life in route to the hospital.

Soon after Melinda's car is stolen by a troubled teenage boy, Kirk Jensen, Kirk's dead mother, Lacy, sends Melinda messages through Electronic Voice Phenomena (EVP) or "white noise" in her car radio and other electronics.

A young bride-to-be is haunted by the dead wife, Ursula, of her fiancé before their upcoming wedding. Melinda learns Ursula died in a car crash on the way to her wedding reception with Mark, and now she can't bear to see Mark marry someone else.

When an up and coming boxing sensation is haunted by the ghost of his mother, whose death caused a rift between him and his father, Melinda must broker peace between them before the mother can crossover.

While Andrea prepares to do standup at a nearby comedy club that is closing its doors, Melinda encounters a troubled dead stand-up comedian (Marty Golden), who is haunting the old comedy club, along with other dead comics.
Melinda's mysterious new neighbor is haunted by an old classmate's dead grandfather, who suspects Tom kidnapped and killed his granddaughter.

The ghost of an executed prisoner seeks Melinda's help in uncovering a contract for his valuable paintings before they're sold and his estranged daughter and struggling artist doesn't see a penny of what the contract says she is entitled to.

When Melinda's first ghost reappears, her presence triggers Melinda to remember when she first discovered her "gift" and the strain it put on her relationship with her mother, who couldn't understand what Melinda was going through.
When the ghost of Andrea's friend starts haunting her, Andrea learns that he was hospitalized in a hiking accident and every time he flat lines, his ghost tries to give her clues.

When Melinda and Andrea help a workaholic fashion designer Christine Greeneauction her belongings, Melinda discovers Christine and her baby daughter's nanny are being haunted by the malicious ghost of Christine's son Daniel.
Sam, Jay and the remaining ghosts unravel the mystery of which ghost passed into the afterlife. Also, Sam and Jay must relocate an owl to do construction on the barn to turn it into Jay's restaurant.
Sam learns that one of the ghosts' powers is to enter the dreams of the living and influence their decisions.

When Jay's sister, Bela (Puna Patel), and her boyfriend, Eric (Andrew Leeds), visit Woodstone Mansion, Eric reveals a major change that took place after his near-death experience there over Christmas.

programmes.st: Halloween 3: The Guest Who Wouldn't Leave
programmes.d: Pete's ex-wife, Carol (Caroline Aaron), shows up at Woodstone Mansion during Sam and Jay's Halloween party, where they're trying to impress some cool friends (John Reynolds and Christine Ko). Also, the ghosts hope to bring Flower back with a séance
A big investor backs out of Sam and Jay's restaurant, leaving them to turn to the one ghost who has money - Isaac.
Trevor's brother, Jeremy (Jon Glaser), checks into Woodstone after discovering a loophole in the Woodstone Rewards Points program.
Alberta hits it off with a poltergeist (Lamorne Morris) who is attached to a newly arrived Woodstone guest. Also, Isaac and Nigel have separate bachelor parties.
When Sam and Jay leave the ghosts home alone for the weekend in an attempt to have a romantic getaway, shocking revelations are made about two of Woodstone's beloved spirits.
Pete discovers a power that he never knew he had – one that brings him closer to his buddy Jay (and further apart).
Isaac's wedding-day jitters are exacerbated by the arrival of a surprise guest in the season three finale.
While Sam and the ghosts race to find him, Isaac comes face to face with Puritan ghost Patience for the first time since she was lost in the dirt.

When Sam's dad (Dean Norris) comes to Woodstone for a visit, Patience (Mary Holland) puts their father-daughter relationship to the test. Also, Isaac must deal with the fallout from his breakup with Nigel and Thor and Flower handle an awkward
The Ghosts, seeking some excitement during a low-key Halloween, join Patience in putting Sam on a witch trial
Trevor, who has catfished his way into a remote financial analyst job, is in hot water when he's summoned to a mandatory in-person work retreat. Also, Hetty and Sass start a rumor about Pete.
Alberta offers to help Sam prepare for an audition for a community theater production. Also, Sass finds a new reason to interfere in Jay's dreams.
When Sam's book publisher requires source material for her biography on Isaac, she and Jay take a field trip to find a diary he claims he hid when he was alive.
When Sam accidentally creates a rift between Sam and Jay's neighbors, the Farnsbys, Henry Farnsby moves into Woodstone B&B. Also, Isaac and Nigel battle over a belated wedding present.
A leaky water heater mishap threatens to ruin holiday plans as Sam and Jay prepare to host Jay's hard-to-please dad, Mahesh, his difficult-to-impress mom, Champa, and his sister, Bela.

Sam and Jay are forced to cover when Mark demands to meet the silent investor in Jay's restaurant, who has been holding up construction.
Thor returns to therapy to work through his angst over being abandoned by his Viking shipmates. Also, Jay's sister, Bela, attempts to help him with the restaurant.

programmes.st: It's the End of the World as We Know It and What Were We Talking About?
programmes.d: Flower interferes with the opening of Jay's restaurant based on a prophecy from her old cult leader.
Jay angers a local restaurateur by using a recipe from his restaurant that Pete gave him.

programmes.st: Alexander Hamilton and the Ruffle Kerfuffle
programmes.d: When Jay becomes obsessed with a fellow chef's success, Isaac serves up a cautionary tale about his own rivalry with Alexander Hamilton. Also, Elias Woodstone returns from hell with a limited-time offer for the ghosts.
When Alberta's descendant hosts a bachelorette party at Woodstone Mansion, Alberta becomes suspicious of her fiancé. Also, Jay is excited about a positive review of his restaurant.
Hetty's ghost power is revealed when Jay's cousin Sunil visits Woodstone Mansion on St. Patrick's Day.
Pete makes good on his promise to find someone for Sasappis by bringing in a wisecracking 1940s screenwriter who can also roam.
Jay, Sam and the ghosts attempt to fix the ghost trap in hopes of getting Sasappis across the ghost boundary to visit his longtime crush, Shiki.
When Trevor's former co-worker, Pinkus (Richie Keen), and his daughter, Abby (Gideon Adlon), show up at Woodstone Mansion, Trevor gets the surprise of his afterlife.

programmes.st: I Know What You Did Thirty-Seven Summers Ago
programmes.d: When Sam and Jay host a fundraiser for the mayor to earn a favor for Jay's restaurant, they learn of his bizarre connection to one of Woodstone's ghosts.
Sam and Jay's relationship is tested when Kyle (Ben Feldman), a handsome living who shares Sam's ability to see ghosts, arrives at Woodstone B&B.

programmes.st: The Devil Went Down to Woodstone
programmes.d: Sam and Jay host a big party for the launch of Sam and Isaac's vampire book.
Sam, Jay and the ghosts attempt to extricate Jay from his deal with Elias Woodstone, the devil.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Halloween of Horror
programmes.d: Veronica's annual Halloween bash turns into chaos when the resurrected Lord of the Vampires crashes the party.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: It Lives in the Sewers
programmes.d: Betty is spooked in the middle of the night when she hears strange noises in her house.
Veronica doesn't think that Archie dotes on her enough, so she visits a witch woman who gives her a magic potion.
A monstrous man of incredible strength is making evening appearances in Riverdale.

Archie and the gang get a taste of what it's like to deal with teenagers when Mr. Weatherbee, Mr. Lodge and Miss Grundy drink bottles of contaminated water, causing them to revert to their wild teenage selves.
Archie buys a pair of mystical fuzzy dice for his beloved car, Betsy, and unwittingly brings her to life when he hangs the dice on her rearview mirror.
In an effort to catch both Veronica and Betty's attention, Reggie attempts to steal some of Dilton's physique enhancing solution.
When Reggie falls in love with a B-movie queen, he buys a magical potion to bring her out of the film and into Riverdale.
Betty begins to mysteriously receive fortune cookies that instruct her to carry out simple good deeds each of which leads to a reward.
Archie is temporarily unable to type, so Reggie offers to write the Weird Mystery article for the school paper.
Evil monsters from a virtual reality game break out and materialize in Riverdale!
A time traveler from the future, with a vendetta against Archie, changes Riverdale's past to alter Archie's present.
When a sunken treasure is found off the coast of Riverdale, Reggie succumbs to the greedy curse of the pirate's gold.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Little Chock'lit Shoppe Of Horrors
programmes.d: In an attempt to make Pop's Chock'lit Shoppe more efficient, Dilton installs some high-tech labor-saving devices which ultimately conflict with Pop's personal attention policy.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: The Day the Earth Moved
programmes.d: Giant, toothy-mawed worms the size of freight trains are plowing beneath the grounds of an old section of Riverdale, eating cars, buildings and anything they can detect moving on the surface.
Veronica treats Jughead like an outsider and excludes him from her guest list for a pool party she's throwing, on the basis that he's different.
Archie has a series of extremely pleasant dreams about a beautiful girl who adores him.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Archie's Date with Fate
programmes.d: When a thief steals a time travel device from Dilton's lab, Archie finds himself trapped in a time loop where he relives the same horrible day over and over again, always ending with the same disastrous date with Veronica.
It's Halloween horror time when Archie discovers vampires in Riverdale.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Dance of the Killer Bees
programmes.d: Humanoid bee creatures begin causing trouble for the people of Riverdale after their leader, the Queen Bee, decides to make the attic of Riverdale High her new hive.
One night, a bright, and glittering shopping mall mysteriously appears in Riverdale.
Government agents are convinced by Jughead's eccentric behavior that he is an advance scout for an alien invasion fleet.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Beware of the Glob!
programmes.d: When Miss Beazely mistakenly uses water from one of Dilton's experiments for her school lunch pudding mix, the school dessert comes to life.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Big Monster on Campus
programmes.d: Moose's athletic supremacy is challenged when he is humiliatingly defeated by a super athlete from Riverdale's rival school, Central high.
Moose is close to being cut from the football team unless he is able to bring his grades up.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Invasion of the Cockroaches
programmes.d: Wanting to attract a new range of clientele, Pop Tate changes his image.
Spooky and mysterious things are happening at Riverdale High.

programmes.t: Archie's Weird Mysteries: Reggie or Not

Lucy is unable to produce her birth certificate to get a passport for the Ricardos' and Mertzes' European jaunt. She calls her hometown for the birth certificate but discovers that none exists for her.

programmes.st: Ricky and Fred Are TV Fans
programmes.d: Dismayed that they can't seem to unglue their husbands from the boxing match on TV, Lucy and Ethel decided to go out for a bite to eat. However, at the local café they run into a similar problem.

programmes.st: The Girls Want to Go to A Nightclub
programmes.d: To celebrate the Mertzes' wedding anniversary, Fred and Ricky want to go to a prizefight, but the girls want to get dressed up and go to a nightclub. An argument ensues and Lucy threatens to find two other escorts if their husbands won't take them.
Mario, the Ricardos' and Mertzes' gondolier in Venice, comes to New York to surprise his brother, but turns up at the Ricardos' apartment when he can't find him.

Ricky insults Lucy's taste in hats so, as a joke, Lucy puts a loving cap trophy on her head that Ricky plans to present to champion jockey Johnny Longden at a National Turf Association dinner later that night. The trophy gets stuck on Lucy's head.
Although Ricky is having lunch with Richard Widmark, he refuses to introduce Lucy because she has become a legend around Hollywood for her crazy escapades.

Lucy anticipates a 2nd honeymoon with Ricky on their boat trip to Europe, but Ricky's band duties keep him too busy. Lucy happily looks forward to romantic evenings and daytime deck games on board the ship as the Ricardos and the Mertzes sail for Europe.

Lucy, unaccustomed to train travel, is sure her trip to New York will be filled with intrigue and romance. When she hears that a jewel thief is on board, she sees herself as the possible heroine of the situation despite Ricky's admonitions to leave.

Fred and Ethel overhear a fight between Ricky and Lucy...or did they? It seems Lucy is reading a murder mystery out loud to the amusement of Ricky. But when Ricky playfully throws the book at Lucy, she ends up with a black eye.

Ricky is working in Monte Carlo, but Fred goofed and bargained for too little money for the engagement. Lucy and Ethel go to the casino to watch, but when Lucy finds a chip that someone dropped and replaces it on the table, it wins and continues to do so.
Ethel complains about how shabby her apartment is. She's ashamed of holding a meeting for the Wednesday Afternoon Fine Arts League at her place where women will be donning minks.

Lucy agrees to help her neighbor Fred Mertz impress an old vaudeville buddy who's in town for a visit. Lucy poses as the Mertzes maid "Bessie" to make Barney Kurtz believe Fred hit it big in real estate.

How long can Ricky Ricardo go, without losing his temper? When Lucy buys a new hat for $49.50, Ricky goes ballistic. To make a point, Lucy bets Ricky the cost of the hat that he'll lose his temper long before her next purchase.

The Ricardos have just purchased a new washing machine and despite their better judgment, agree to sell their old one to the Mertzes. The next day the old machine explodes with water and suds and the Mertzes insist that the deal is off.

The Ricardos and Mertzes, impatient with their egg selling business, decide that they must trade in their 500 chicks for 200 egg laying hens. However, after a couple of weeks, these hens don't yield many eggs at all.
When Ben Benjamin arrives at the Ricardos' apartment, Lucy mistakes Ben Benjamin, a Hollywood talent scout, for a burglar and nearly ruins Ricky's chance for a film career.

Lucy's mother wants to join the Ricardos on their road trip out west. As anticipated, Ricky blows his stack when he hears that Lucy's mother wants to go along, and continues to complain that everyone's going on the trip.

Lucy decides Ricky's love is growing cold so she takes Ethel's advice she learned from a book, How to Keep the Honeymoon from Ending. Her attempt to dress up for breakfast doesn't yield any response from Ricky.

Although there are perks to living in their new country home, like House & Garden wanting to do a spread on them, the Ricardos find that it is expensive in Connecticut. Lucy decides to raise chickens and sell eggs as a moneymaking sideline.

Hurt that no one seems to care for his home movies, Ricky declares that he will never show them another feature of his...not even the TV pilot he's creating. Jealous of his project, Lucy enables the help of the Mertzes and creates her own musical western.
Lucy learns a movie star, Cornel Wilde, is staying in the penthouse directly above the Ricardos' apartment and sets out to catch a glimpse of the handsome actor.

programmes.st: Little Ricky Learns To Play The Drums
programmes.d: Although they both agree not to try and influence Little Ricky's future, Lucy buys a toy doctor kit and Ricky gives him a drum set. Their son takes to the drums and begins to play it non-stop for days.

Lucy convinces Ricky to allow her to buy a Don Loper dress so she'll fit in with the Hollywood scene. Lucy and Ethel hit the couturier's salon but soon realize the dresses are way out of their price range.

Ricky begins wearing a hat around the apartment because he thinks he's going bald. Lucy thinks he's worrying needlessly but goes to a store that specializes in hair restoration in order to help Ricky feel better.
Ricky has planned a surprise party for Lucy's birthday and swears the Mertzes and all their friends to secrecy. Lucy, however, only knows that everyone has forgotten her birthday.

Lucy and Ethel acquire a walk-in meat freezer. In an attempt to save money, they order two sides of beef, not realizing this is a tremendous amount. Hundreds of pounds of meat and $483 later, they must figure out a way to unload the beef.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are on the deck of the Constitution, ready to set sail for Europe when Lucy rushes down the gangplank for one last goodbye to Little Ricky who will be in her mother's care while she is away.

Lucy is jealous after Ricky dances with Angela Randall, an up-and-coming British actress. She gets Ricky away from her by going to the country estate of Sir Clive Richardson, a prominent English film producer, for a fox hunt he is hosting.
The Ricardos and Mertzes are on a train for Rome when Lucy is 'discovered' by an Italian film director who offers her a role in his new picture, "Bitter Grapes".
Lucy gets caught up in a tormenting cycle of buying a useless appliance from a fast-talking salesman, then trading it in for something more expensive when trying to return it.

The Ricardos' infant is cranky and keeps his parents as well as their neighbors up at night. When a neighbor, Mrs. Trumbull points out that the lease forbids children and threatens to move out along with other tenants.

Ricky is offered a European booking that is too important to refuse but he can't afford to take Lucy with him. Lucy is furious at the prospect of being left behind, and when Ricky wants to take Fred Mertz along as the tour manager, Ethel too, is incensed.

The Ricardos are anxious about their move to the country. Reality really sets in when Fred shows their apartment to a young couple. The Taylors will take the apartment but need to move in immediately.
Canvases bare all in a revealing Flash Challenge, and New York Yankees pitcher CC Sabathia judges artists' tattoo placements in the Elimination Challenge.
The artists design tattoos for X-Men superfans in the Flash Challenge, canvases sit for a color portrait Elimination Tattoo, and actor Hugh Jackman is a guest judge.
The artists test their adaptability in the Flash Challenge, brokenhearted canvases seek coverup tattoos, and guest judge Freddy Corbin helps to eliminate two more artists.
An artist has a tense altercation with a judge, gunpowder is used to create designs in the Flash Challenge, and guest Rob Zombie assesses horror-themed Elimination Tattoos.
Boxing champion Brandon Rios tasks the artists with designing him custom mouth grills, tensions flare between an artist and a canvas, and an artist is accused of plagiarism.
Relationships between the artists are tested with a collaborative Elimination Challenge, and traditional tattoo expert Luke Wessman helps the judges send one more artist home.
Canvases sit for a Statue of Liberty tattoo in the Flash Challenge, the artists design snake-themed Elimination Tattoos, and tattoo expert Taki is a guest judge.
The artists design tattoos for breast cancer survivors, and the artists are tasked with a convention-style coverup challenge.
The artists and judges reflect on their experiences during the season, Kyle Dunbar confronts Chris Nunez, and America's votes are tallied to crown a new Ink Master.
Competing for $100,000 and the title of Ink Master, 18 rival artists are forced to ink with their enemy.
Actor Joe Manganiello joins as a guest judge in a semi-nude Flash Challenge, and rivalries flare as the artists struggle through a pinup Elimination Tattoo.
Two artists receive an advantage no one in the competition has ever had, and the artists create complex ornamental-style Elimination Tattoos.
The artists head to Wall Street for a cutthroat Flash Challenge, and canvases sit for traditional Japanese geisha tattoos.
The artists team up to create artwork by sandblasting glass, and the pressure is on during an animal-style Elimination Tattoo.
The artists are given 12 hours to complete a glute tattoo, one artist faces a medical emergency, and things heat up when the artists must complete one another's tattoos.
The artists must complete a tag-team American traditional tattoo, and the judges leave it up to the artists to put one of their teammates on the chopping block.
The artists must scrimshaw a walrus oosik in the Flash Challenge, a difficult canvas jeopardizes an artist's spot in the competition, and artist Aaron Cain is a guest judge.
In order to defeat Naraku, Kagura looks for Sesshomaru. She appears before Rin and Jaken, but Sesshomaru is away.

programmes.st: The Mysterious Light that Guides the Saint
programmes.d: Kagome and the others sense Kikyo's presence from the purifying arrow. Meanwhile, Abihime attacks the village.

programmes.st: The Girl Who Overcame Time…and the Boy Who Was Just Overcome
programmes.d: In feudal Japan, the half demon Inuyasha was sealed away by the priestess Kikyo. Many years later he is revived by Kagome.
Kagome finds out that she may be the reincarnation of Kaede's late older sister, the priestess Kikyo, who sealed Inuyasha with her arrow.

programmes.st: Down the Rabbit Hole and Back Again
programmes.d: Kagome has the ability to see pieces of the Shikon Jewel. Inuyasha has the power to defeat demons. Both of their powers are needed to gather the shards of the jewel.
Kagome has returned to the present day and is relaxing in her home when Inuyasha comes looking for her. Some of Yura's demonic hair is on his body.
Kagome learns that Inuyasha is a half demon, born of a human mother and a dog demon.
The muonna makes Inuyasha reveal the location of his father's grave.
Kagome is able to pull out the Tetsusaiga. Sesshomaru tries to kill her, and Inuyasha is angered and fights to protect Kagome.

programmes.st: The Toad Who Would Be Prince
programmes.d: Nobunaga tries to save the lord of the castle who is possessed by a toad demon.
Shippo is a demon fox whose father was killed by the the Thunder Brothers: Hiten and Manten.

programmes.st: Phantom Showdown–The Thunder Brothers vs. Tetsusaiga
programmes.d: Inuyasha goes to save Kagome from Manten. Hiten devours the sacred jewel shard that Manten had and absorbs his demon powers.

programmes.st: Terror of the Ancient Noh Mask
programmes.d: Kagome has returned to the present day to take a test. As she does, a noh mask, the Mask of Flesh, begins a violent search for the Shikon Jewel shards.

programmes.st: The Soul Piper and the Mischievous Little Soul
programmes.d: Kagome sees a Soul Piper, a demon that consoles the spirits of children. She helps Mayu, a girl who is about to become an evil spirit, to pass on.

programmes.st: The Mystery of the New Moon and the Black-haired Inuyasha
programmes.d: Half demon Inuyasha's secret is that he becomes human once a month. That day, Inuyasha and the gang meet Nazuna and stay at a mountain temple.
The ogress, Urasue, robs the grave of Kikyo, the priestess who sealed away Inuyasha fifty years ago.

programmes.st: Return of the Tragic Priestess, Kikyo
programmes.d: Kikyo is revived when Kagome's soul flows into her. She tries to kill Inuyasha, but Kagome takes back her soul.

programmes.st: Mystical Hand of the Amorous Monk, Miroku
programmes.d: Miroku, a womanizing delinquent priest, has been collecting Shikon Jewel shards and steals Kagome's shards.

programmes.st: The Cursed Ink of the Hell-Painter
programmes.d: Kotatsu, a painter, sees a dream in which he becomes successful by controlling an army of ogres drawn with ink that has a sacred jewel shard in it.
Naraku appears before Sesshomaru and lends him an arm with a sacred jewel shard embedded in it.

programmes.st: Go Back to Your Own Time, Kagome!
programmes.d: Sesshomaru wields the Tetsusaiga with his borrowed arm against Inuyasha, who fights back with his scabbard.

programmes.st: Despicable Villain! The Mystery of Onigumo!
programmes.d: Kagome has her sacred jewel shards taken away from her and is returned to the present day, unable to return to feudal Japan.
Kagome returns to the shrine in the middle of her date with Hojo. She senses the presence of the Shikon Jewel shards and returns to feudal Japan.

programmes.st: A Wicked Smile; Kikyo's Wandering Soul
programmes.d: Kikyo, who was brought back to life, is living as a priestess.
Kikyo paralyzes Kagome. Inuyasha appears before her. Kikyo has been gathering the souls of dead girls.

programmes.t: Inuyasha Movie 4: Fire on the Mystic Island (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Inuyasha faces the Four War Gods and the past he left behind on Horai Island fifty years ago.
Sango, a demon slayer, is invited to Hitomi Castle along with her father, the leader of the demon slayers, and her younger brother, Kohaku.
Sango fights Inuyasha, believing him to be her enemy. Naraku's plan is to have her fight to the death using the power of the Shikon Jewel shard.

programmes.st: The Secret of the Sacred Jewel Revealed!
programmes.d: Sango reveals the secret story of the Shikon Jewel's birth.

programmes.st: The Lake of the Evil Water God
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet Taromaru, the son of a village leader. They go to the Temple of the Water God, where children are being sacrificed.

After Jane and Rafael decide to send Mateo to a new school, they become guilt-ridden when they are forced to lie to get him in.
Jane and Rafael realize that the uncertain state of their relationship is stressing out Mateo and they decide they need to make a decision.
Jane and Rafael try to be friends which works great until Jane goes on a date.  Petra and Jane's new partnership is off to a rocky start, but they know they have to find a way through it.
Jane is ready to move on from the Marbella and pursue writing full time, but an unexpected development forces her to consider returning to her teaching roots.
Jane's fixation on a negative review has left her with writer's block, so Rogelio suggests she take a class to help.
When Jane, Rogelio and Alba learn what is going on with Xo, they all try to comfort her, but Xo insists they let her live her life.
Xo struggles to make an important decision and looks to Jane for guidance leaving Rogelio feeling like an outsider.
After Jane, Rafael, Petra and JR all go out together, Jane is upset to learn that JR doesn't like her. Jane and Rafael brush off a big relationship moment, but they try to make up for it.
Jane and Rafael find themselves in a not ideal living situation in order to save money.  When Rafael sees Alba try to punish Mateo, an unexpected rift is formed.
Jane believes she and Rafael are in a good place until she realizes he is keeping a secret from her.  Alba's big day has finally arrived, and Jane, Xo and Rogelio are ready to celebrate.

Jane makes a shocking discovery and looks to Rafael for answers, but is confused by his decision to put everything they have on hold. Meanwhile, Petra is trying to secure a future with JR, but her past might jeopardize everything.

With Jane's Catholic guilt starting to settle in, she turns to Alba for advice and gets an unexpected answer. Luisa decides to go see Rose with Rafael by her side, in order to help get answers. Meanwhile, Rogelio is back to work with River.

Two sisters feud over the family heritance ends up in Judge Marilyn Milian's court room

After Manny makes a wish on a magic amulet, his dog Rufus turns into a real boy, and the two rule the school.
After stumbling across a cloning machine, Adam Baker creates multiple versions of himself and finds the answer to handling his many summer responsibilities!
A team of six clever kids enacts a daring plan to track down a swindler and bring him to justice.

Quincy is a thirty-something baggage handler by day and online video game master by night. Perfectly happy to live in his parents' home, Quincy has dedicated his life to being the best cyber athlete online, until his parents decide to move.

Vic and Owen find themselves, along with Sinjin, in the middle of a massive dino-fight in the old Jurassic Park Visitor Center!
It's déjà vu for Alan Grant as he returns to Isla Nublar and winds up stranded in the jungle during a dangerous storm with injured Simon and hero-worshipping Owen!

The Ninja celebrate their escape from the Vermillion Army and their retrieval of the Emerald Time Blade, but with Acronix and Krux determined to get their Blade back, the Airjitzu Temple becomes a battleground.

Secrets are revealed as Nya confronts the Samurai X imposter, Kai pursues the truth about his parents and the other Ninja desperately seek to locate and rescue Master Wu. But as usual, some answers only lead to more questions.
Kai confronts his dad for aiding the Hands of Time, only to discover that his parents are actually Acronix and Krux's captives.

programmes.st: Out of the Fire and Into the Boiling Sea
programmes.d: The Hands of Time blackmail Kai and Nya into using their combined Elemental powers to retrieve the fourth and final Time Blade from the Boiling Sea with the promise that the siblings can use its reversal power to save the quickly-fading Master Wu.

Kai and Nya stow away aboard Krux and Acronix’s time-traveling snake mech in a desperate attempt to save Master Wu. But when they arrive in the past, they must help the Elemental Masters prevent the Hands of Time from re-writing Ninjago history.
Logan's desperation to prove himself leads to his capture by the Nightmare King,which leaves his friends to face the Sheep Week finals alone.
The Dream Chasers rush to save Logan from the Shadowkeep's dungeon,but the liberators soon become the prisoners in a nightmarish twist of fate.
A mysterious dome blocks Mateo and the others from leaving their dream landing, and Zoey and Albert are their only hope of escape.
With Albert captured by the Night Hunter and Z-Blob detained by Agent Strick, it's time for a dual rescue in the Waking World and the Dream World!
Detective Izzie takes the case of Mateo's missing comic book while Nova, the head of the Insomniacs, probes into a mystery of her own.
The hunt for the Sandman, the only one who can repair Lunia's hourglass, brings the kids to the dangerous Murky Realm, where memories go to die!
Determined to give the Insomniac's a night of good dreams, Izzie and friends bring them to the Candy Realm; but nowhere is safe from Nightmare King.
Desperate to save his daughter, Tormak betrays the Phoenix and steals the Map known as the Artifact. But the theft does not go as planned.
Saddened to see his father distraught over the loss of the Map and his best friend Tormak, Flinx boldly sneaks off to confront Fangar on his own but falls into a clever trap.
Chima is frozen. The heroes trapped in the Gorge of Eternal Depth. The Hunters are preparing their ultimate assault on the Lion City and Mt. Cavora.

Time is running out. But if the heroes can discover the locations of the fabled and powerful Fire Wings before the Hunters reach Mount Cavora, they may still stand a chance. But to do so, they must learn to think like Phoenix.

It's always fun to share a day with Barney—but it's also important to learn how to "play it safe!"  Baby Bop, wanting to be a good helper, has been attaching adhesive strips to her frustrated (and uninjured) brother, BJ.

While Barney has fun with his friends every day, there's something special about making a brand NEW friend!  When Mr. Boyd's niece, Colleen visits the park, she's eager to make friends with the other kids...but being the "new kid" isn't easy.
The children bring toys to donate to Mr. Boyd's toy drive.  Baby Bop and BJ arrive and after some convincing, Baby Bop learns about the merits of sharing.

After playing with "Stop" and "Go" signs with Angela, Baby Bop leaves to direct some traffic of her own!  Meanwhile, in the caboose, Barney and the kids enjoy a costume parade, a game of "Musical Stop & Go," and some very vigorous body movement.
Barney and the kids help Baby Bop count to ten by playing games, and visiting a Make-Believe Market.
When Miss Jo loses her cat, Barney and the children spend the day helping her find it.  Along the way, they learn all about cats.
While Barney and the children wait for Mr. Boyd's new fountain to be delivered, they have fun playing in and exploring the park.

Tony shares a box full of numbers that he made with his dad.  He is showing them off when a gust of wind blows them all away.  Barney and the kids decide to go on a number hunt.  They soon find Baby Bop and their hunt takes the group all over the park.
The children learn about many different countries while experiencing an “International Fair” on the playground.
A day of imaginative play and fun for Barney and his young friends is kicked off by the arrival of a variety of boxes from the "Enjoy-Your-Toys Company."  Surprisingly, every box is empty!
The kids have put together a "Caboose Color Collection" which showcases the primary colors—red, yellow and blue.  Barney and Baby Bop enjoy songs and games suggested by the colorful objects.

It's a rainy spring day, and the children can be found inside painting and creating.  Barney arrives, explains the differences amongst the seasons, and suggests playing outside in the rain.  The rain is soon replaced by sunshine and a rainbow.
Barney and his friends play hopscotch—with a twist.  Whitney is learning about triangles at school, so Angela created Triangle Hopscotch to help reinforce "triangles."
Every day with Barney is fun—but today is extra special.  It's Barney's birthday!
Mario is trying to write his very own fairy tale.  The children help by acting out some of their favorite fairy tales to give Mario some ideas.

Barney helps Baby Bop and the children discover big and little things in the world around them.  And by the end of the day, the kids have learned that big or little, they're all wonderful just the way they are!
Nick's homework is to find as many squares as he can.  It's great fun when Barney and the kids help!

When Sarah accidentally spills red paint into the blue paint, a mess turns into a perfectly purple day.  The children paint pictures, make purple flowers and plan a purple party for their friend Colleen.

Barney and the kids are excited because five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing buddies are putting on a show in the park tonight!  Angela is learning to play the trumpet and knows that it takes a lot of practice.  BJ arrives and the group visits the caboose.

programmes.st: This Way In, This Way Out!
programmes.d: Angela is in the park to release her turtle after observing him with her classmates in school.  Barney and the children discuss the meaning of in and out after observing the turtle going in and out of his shell.
Kami, one of Barney's youngest friends, has trouble keeping up with the other kids and she's tired of always being last.  She's not having a very good day.
Throughout the day, Barney and the children learn about "hot" and "cold," but the fun really begins when Barney turns the playground into a winter/summer wonderland!

It's the day of the bike parade.  But Nick has had a bike accident that leaves his bike in need of repair by Mr. Boyd.  Barney helps Baby Bop and the children learn all about bicycles—and that they are a wonderful way to exercise and have fun.

The children are surprised to learn that playing games and having fun in the park is great exercise.  Baby Bop is happy to learn that not only is she exercising while she plays, but exercise will make her grow big and strong.
A tea party planned by the children turns into a fun opportunity to reinforce lessons about good manners!  Throughout the day, Baby Bop is given helpful advice.
With a little Barney magic, the children experience the differences between day and night!
Through pretend play, Barney, and the children learn about their community and the people that help them live safely and happily there.
Barney, Baby Bop and the kids learn all about “on” and “off” by playing games together.

Beth has invented a brand-new holiday called "Happy Day," in which everyone gets to make a wish for something which will make them happy—and everyone else tries to make that wish come true!  Barney and the kids discuss feelings and facial expressions.
After a brief misunderstanding, BJ realizes he has many friends.  He enjoys a day playing with Barney and the children.
A "too hot" afternoon becomes a "totally cool" day when Barney introduces his friends to the wonders of water.
Barney and the children have fun playing with and learning about busses and cars.

The children are invited to a family picnic in the park, but don't know who invited them.  The invitations instruct them to bring a family treasure, so each child has something special with them.  Barney helps lead a discussion about families.
