When testifying as a witness in a robbery case, Matlock is made to look like a fool. It soon becomes apparent that someone is playing tricks on him that threaten his credibility and safety.

An Army lieutenant pushes his men too hard. Someone stabs him in the back, and he dies. The Army charges one of the soldiers in his company, Ben defends him, and Charlene and Tyler help. During a preliminary hearing the accused disappears.

Ben returns the defendant, but a crucial witness (the only witness) disappears. Tyler discovers a drug scheme, Charlene finds out about the background, and Ben figures out the pieces of the puzzle. Ben even learns about the Army.
Matlock’s murder defense of Allison Tate, a young heiress with a history of mental instability, is complicated by Warren Kreitzer, a New York lawyer who is responsible for her trust fund.

Director of an amateur stage production, Doug Michaels fires would-be actor Ben Matlock from his role as a detective, claiming he’s seen kumquats with more talent. However, the tables soon turn when Michaels is accused of murdering the leading lady.

When a member of the Law Club disappears, it becomes apparent that each of the students in Matlock's law class had a motive. Matlock wonders if he taught someone how to commit the perfect crime, and sets out to discover if it really was.

Young Brian Martell is accused of murdering a famous playwright – just as his father was charged with murdering the playwright’s father forty years ago! In untangling a web of secrets and adultery, Matlock and his father uncover the shocking truth.

Young Brian Martell is accused of murdering a famous playwright – just as his father was charged with murdering the playwright’s father forty years ago! In untangling a web of secrets and adultery, Matlock and his father uncover the shocking truth.
It’s a race against time as Matlock tries to save conman Adam Spangler from being executed for a murder he claims he never committed.
A maid is accused of killing an employer.

Beware of the black widow! A jealous girlfriend is a dangerous woman and Ray, one half of the popular Rick & Ray radio talk show, has the bullets in his chest to prove it! Now Matlock must get the evidence he needs to convict, but it won’t be easy.
When a successful country music star is murdered, the promoter she fired – Steve Fisher – becomes the logical suspect.
Against Matlock’s approval, his associate, Cliff Lewis, advertises for a private client. He is hired by a flaky woman who becomes the main suspect in the murder of the plastic surgeon she sued.
A plastic surgeon’s murder leads Matlock into a chain of events and murder involving a wealthy family.
Matlock comes to the defense of popular game show host Dennis Blake who’s accused of the murder of his successful, yet despised mega-millionaire producer.

Katie Clark, the new assistant D.A. in town, is trying to juggle the demands of being a single parent and perform a stellar job on her first prosecution case. But, to her horror, she learns that the suspect she’s trying to convict is her former lover.
Matlock’s on jury duty, and the case against a man-about-town who stands to gain a fortune from his wife’s death seems airtight. Close examination of the evidence suggests otherwise to Ben.
The IMF is called upon to end an inhuman situation which the United Nations has been unable to abolish: slave trade in the country of Elkabar, ruled by King Ibn Borca.
The IMF continues to battle slave-trading in a Middle Eastern country by eliminating De Groot, one of the principal suppliers of victims for King Borca's slave market.
The team must break a Communist assassin who killed a U.S. Senator.
Guest star Joan Collins, as a seductive double agent, endangers a vital IMF project when Jim Phelps falls in love with her.
The IMF attempts to clear an American businessman in Japan of false charges that he murdered his Japanese wife in "Butterfly," a segment of Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible" series.
William Shatner guest stars as an aging hoodlum who is artificially transplanted back to the 1930s and the scene of his unsolved crime.

Jim Phelps leads the IMF to aid one of its own members when Barney is arrested and marked for execution by a sadistic police chief (guest star Pernell Roberts) on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Paris, still in his cover from a completed mission, is kidnapped and held hostage by a group of treacherous revolutionists in "The Hostage" on Paramount Television's award-winning series "Mission: Impossible."
Henry Darrow guest stars as Gregory Tolan, the local leader of a revolutionist group specializing in robberies for the financing of a movement to overthrow the United States government in the "Blast"
Sal Mineo guest stars as a ruthless young operator who heads up an international narcotics ring which the IMF attempts to break up on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

While rescuing an imprisoned patriot, Barney is critically wounded and must be left behind in order for the IMF to complete their mission in the "Hunted" episode of Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
The IMF team goes in as a circus team to rescue Anton Cardinal Vossek, who is being held in the impregnable Seravno Prison.
Rollin manages to avoid the guards and get to the roof but is arrested before he can rescue Vossek.

The Impossible Missions Force must end the murderous career of a bacteriologist working for the enemy, who has succeeded in developing a mutant strain of a deadly bacteria which could be used as a practical battlefield weapon.

Guest stars Noel Harrison and Diane Baker are drawn into a daring IMF charade that uses a trained falcon to help in a crown jewel theft in the first of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Barney is blinded in an accident, a bride-to-be is buried alive and Paris poses as a man he is unaware is marked for death in the second of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

A trained falcon is summoned in a last-ditch rescue attempt when Jim Phelps finds his IMF endangered by a traitor's assassination plot in the last of a three-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

Bill Nye, “the Science Guy” stops by to show a science experiment using baking soda and vinegar to blow up a balloon. Mister Rogers shows a video of dump trucks at a construction site, and in Make-Believe, all that was lost is found.

programmes.st: Be Yourself: Visit with David Copperfield
programmes.d: Magician David Copperfield teaches Mister Rogers how to do a magic trick. It takes lots of practice. In Make-Believe, X is giving flying lessons, and there's a video of what the world looks like from a bird's point of view.

programmes.st: Visit with the Uptown String Quartet
programmes.d: Prince Tuesday is upset about being unable to fly, so Lady Elaine gives him a propeller hat. He jumps off the castle wall, thinking the hat will make him fly, and injures his arm. Mister Rogers visits the Uptown String Quartet.

X says he is feeling guilty about Prince Tuesday's fall. Neighbor Aber says it was not X's flying lessons that made Prince Tuesday get hurt. Mister Rogers shows a video about people making sleeping bags. He visits the workshop of the doll maker.

programmes.st: Feeling Good About Who We Are
programmes.d: Hula-hoop expert Paul Tifford gives Mister Rogers some lessons. It takes a lot of practice to be able to use a hula-hoop well, and falling and getting up again are a part of learning!

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Puts on a Vest!
programmes.d: Instead of changing into a sweater as he typically does, Mister Rogers puts on a vest made by his friend Saihou Njie. Trolley brings a batik cloth to Handyman Negri, who then gives it to King Friday.

Mister Rogers arrives with a children's plastic potty, takes it to his bathroom and compares it to the adult-sized toilet. Prince Tuesday comes up with a game using a bucket but has had his feelings hurt when his father was not impressed.

King Friday denounces the magic finder balloon. Neighbors Aber and Robert Troll are looking for Lady Elaine. They find her locked in a room of the Museum-Go-Round. At Mister Rogers' house, Levar Burton reads “The Daddy Book.”

Mister Rogers explains how a wheelchair lift works, and then shows one in action. He shows some of his puppets. Mayor Maggie and Neighbor Aber ride in a wheelchair until they have their checkups from Dr. Bill.

programmes.st: Field Trip to Visit Koko the Gorilla
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits with Koko the gorilla, who has learned how to communicate in sign language. In Make-Believe, there's a gorilla, too, who seems scary until the neighbors get to know him. And there's a video of how people make play balls.

programmes.st: An Eye Exam for Mister Rogers
programmes.d: At the eye doctor's office, Mister Rogers takes part in a general eye examination. The gorilla catches Lady Aberlin as she stumbles, which alarms Lady Elaine Fairchild. Lady Elaine is determined to catch the gorilla.

programmes.st: A Boy and His Service Dog
programmes.d: Mr. McFeely stops by with a film about a service dog aiding a handicapped child. Mister Rogers visits with the boy from the video and his dog. Lady Elaine Fairchile continues her efforts to catch the gorilla. Neighbor Aber is missing.
Mister Rogers reads a book about a dog named Zak. There's also a video visit to the Center for Creative Play, a place where children of all abilities can play.

Marilyn Barnett brings someone who has great talent with yo-yos. Mister Rogers shows a film of how people make wooden yo-yos. Prince Tuesday plays well with the yo-yo, but King Friday does not. Therefore, the king outlaws yo-yos.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Rides In a Helicopter
programmes.d: Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely ride with Maria Mancano on a helicopter. Miss Paulificate and Lady Aberlin have been assigned the duty of “yo-yo guard,” responsible for upholding the King's ban on yo-yos.

Mr. McFeely shows a photo album with pictures of Neighbors wearing different hats. Lady Aberlin informs King Friday that Lady Elaine's helicopter, Yo-Yo, is stuck in the air. King Friday commands that all references to yo-yos be removed.

programmes.st: Musician Yo-Yo Ma and Inventor Chuck Hoberman
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows a video of inventor Chuck Hoberman with his sphere and a video of Yo-Yo and Nicholas Ma. The neighbors are waiting for Bob Dog's helicopter to land. They discover that the helicopter responds to guitar music.

Mister Rogers visits Maya Lin at her studio to see how she first makes small models of big things she is working on. They go to Penn Station to see what she created there. In Make-Believe, there's a video visit with cellist Yo-Yo Ma.

programmes.st: MAJOR PANIC! DESPERATE STRUGGLE AT THE AUCTION HOUSE
programmes.d: Luffy turns a mermaid auction into a pirate-style brawl when he knocks the snot out of a Celestial Dragon. With a fleet of marines out to get them, the Straw Hats will have to fight their way off the island!

programmes.st: ADMIRAL KIZARU TAKES ACTION! SABAODY ARCHIPELAGO THROWN INTO CHAOS
programmes.d: They saved Camie from the auction block, but now the Straw Hats are surrounded by a fleet of marines. Lucky for Luffy, Eustass "Captain" Kidd and Trafalgar Law are ready to join the fight!

programmes.st: BREAK THROUGH THE SIEGE! THE NAVY VS. THE THREE CAPTAINS
programmes.d: The Straw Hats join forces with Kidd's crew and Trafalgar's mates to make short work of the marines, but they're in for a surprise when they encounter a Warlord of the Sea!

programmes.st: ROGER AND RAYLEIGH - THE KING OF THE PIRATES AND HIS RIGHT HAND MAN
programmes.d: Luffy and his crew duck the marines by hiding out at Rayleigh's house. While Chopper tends to Hachi, Rayleigh entertains the Straw Hats with tales of his days as first mate on Gold Roger's ship.

programmes.st: NO ESCAPE!? ADMIRAL KIZARU'S LIGHT SPEED KICK!!
programmes.d: Admiral Kizaru has arrived to lead the marines on a mission to wipe out all pirates. Meanwhile, Luffy and his crew prepare for a deadly battle with one of the Warlords of the Sea!

programmes.st: OVERWHELMING! THE NAVY'S FIGHTING WEAPONS, THE PACIFISTAS
programmes.d: A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a Warlord lookalike.

programmes.st: AN EVEN STRONGER ENEMY APPEARS! THE BATTLE AXE-CARRYING SENTOMARU
programmes.d: Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far deadlier foe comes looking for a fight.

programmes.st: ADMIRAL KIZARU'S FIERCE ASSAULT / THE STRAW HATS FACE CERTAIN DEATH!
programmes.d: Zoro's barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.

programmes.st: ELIMINATED FRIENDS - THE FINAL DAY OF THE STRAW HAT CREW
programmes.d: One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?

programmes.st: FEUDAL ERA SIDE STORY / BOSS LUFFY APPEARS AGAIN
programmes.d: Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a Warlord of the Sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!

programmes.st: FEUDAL ERA SIDE STORY / DEFEAT THRILLER COMPANY'S TRAP!
programmes.d: Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!

programmes.st: LANDING! THE ALL-FEMALE ISLAND, AMAZON LILY
programmes.d: Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man's amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!

programmes.st: HURRY BACK TO YOUR FRIENDS! THE MAIDEN ISLAND ADVENTURE
programmes.d: An army of scantily-clad women warriors want to investigate Luffy's family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.

programmes.st: EVERYONE FALLS IN LOVE! PIRATE EMPRESS HANCOCK
programmes.d: The women chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she's about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!

programmes.st: THE SECRET HIDDEN ON THE BACKS / LUFFY AND THE SNAKE PRINCESS MEET
programmes.d: Luffy's search for a seaworthy vessel leads to a "drop-in" on the Snake Princess during the royal bathing hour. The view is world-class, but it might turn the rubber-man to stone!

programmes.st: HEARTLESS JUDGMENT! MARGARET IS TURNED TO STONE!!
programmes.d: Boa Hancock makes Luffy mad when she turns Margaret into a statue. The Snake Princess may have bitten off more than she can chew by challenging the captain of the Straw Hats!

programmes.st: A DIFFICULT FIGHT FOR LUFFY! THE SNAKE SISTERS' HAKI POWER!!
programmes.d: The Snake Princess pits Luffy's Gum-Gum abilities against the incredible Haki power of her serpentine sisters in a fight to the death. Will Luffy survive long enough to save his statuesque friends?

programmes.st: ALL-OUT SPECIAL POWER BATTLE!! GUM-GUM VS. SNAKE-SNAKE
programmes.d: Luffy kicks his attack mode into Second Gear to save a precious statue, and the snake sisters start to feel the Straw Hat heat. At the battle's climax, Luffy makes an impression on his opponents.

programmes.st: HANCOCK'S CONFESSION--  THE SISTERS' ABHORRENT PAST
programmes.d: News of Luffy's run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?

programmes.st: SAVING ACE! THE NEXT STOP: THE GREAT PRISON
programmes.d: Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty Kuja women eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him a safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.

programmes.st: LOVE IS A HURRICANE! LOVE-LOVE HANCOCK
programmes.d: Boa Hancock's illness threatens to sabotage Luffy's rescue mission. However, the Snake Princess just can't say "no" to the rubber-man, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.

programmes.st: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! THE SCIENCE OF WEATHER AND THE MECHANICAL ISLAND
programmes.d: While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!

programmes.st: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! AN ISLAND OF GIANT BIRDS AND A PINK PARADISE!
programmes.d: Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji's refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of girlish hearts.

programmes.st: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! BRIDGING THE ISLANDS AND VICIOUS VEGETATION!
programmes.d: Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!

programmes.st: THE FRIENDS' WHEREABOUTS! A NEGATIVE PRINCESS AND THE KING OF DEMONS!
programmes.d: Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!

programmes.st: A DEADLY INFILTRATION! THE UNDERWATER PRISON IMPEL DOWN
programmes.d: Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace's execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!

programmes.st: A REUNION IN HELL?! THE MAN WHO ATE THE CHOP-CHOP FRUIT!
programmes.d: Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who's going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There's no love lost between the former foes, but they'd better work together if they want to survive.

programmes.st: BREAK THROUGH THE CRIMSON HELL! BUGGY'S CHAOS-INDUCING PLAN
programmes.d: Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down's Crimson Hell!

programmes.st: THE STRONGEST MAN IN THE PRISON! POISON MAN MAGELLAN APPEARS
programmes.d: Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren't careful in Impel Down's Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubber-man might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison's putrid warden!

programmes.st: A SPECIAL PRESENTATION RELATED TO THE MOVIE /  A GOLD LION'S AMBITION ON THE MOVE
programmes.d: Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!

programmes.st: A SPECIAL PRESENTATION RELATED TO THE MOVIE / LITTLE EAST BLUE IN DANGER
programmes.d: The citizens of Little East Blue throw in a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the Beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.

programmes.st: A SPECIAL PRESENTATION RELATED TO THE MOVIE / THE FIERCE ONSLAUGHT OF THE AMIGO PIRATES
programmes.d: Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji prepare to do battle on behalf of Boss the Beetle, but Captain Largo of the Amigo Pirates counters with a deadly arsenal of nets to put the Straw Hat brawlers on lock down!

programmes.st: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie/ The Battle is on! Luffy Vs. Largo
programmes.d: Luffy kicks into Second Gear for his rematch with Largo, and Nami leads the islanders as they lay waste to the Amigo Pirates. Boss the Beetle may be safe for now, but someone sinister lurks behind the scenes.

The guys visit a Kentucky property with a racetrack that revives an old Mike & Frank rivalry. Later, a freestyle stop in North Carolina looks like a bust until they unearth a one-of-a-kind TV relic.
Mike and Frank are freestyling in Minnesota where they stumble on salvage operator Terry who has a staggering scrap yard. Everything is for sale, including a mother lode of retro signage.
Leaving Iowa in the dead of winter, Mike and Frank head south to New Orleans. There they stumble upon a quirky antique dealer with a sprawling collection.
Driving along the back roads of Tennessee in the early morning fog, Mike and Frank are brushing up on their Southern expressions when they spot an awesome property.

Danielle is jealous when the guys take Mike's young nephew on his first pick instead of her. But 12-year-old Rhesa is thrilled, especially when the trio starts exploring Danny Bean's sprawling property.
The Pawn Stars snap to attention as they check out a photo album signed by one of history's greatest military leaders--General George S. Patton.
The Pawn Stars run for their lives when they come face-to-face with the fire-breathing, 31-ton mammoth Robosaurus.
The Old Man has an opportunity to buy lost footage of legendary President Franklin Delano Roosevelt.

Get revved up with the Pawn Stars as they check out a rare REO Flying Cloud hot rod from the 1930s. Will Rick muster the strength to crank up an offer for this classic ride or will the deal take a detour and sputter out?

Corey has a chance to buy a wooden crossbow that hasn't been fired in almost 40 years--will it hold together and hit its mark or splinter, crack and fracture the deal? Meanwhile Rick blushes when a woman tries to sell her husband's Playboy collection.
The Pawn Stars travel to Utah for a rare shot at a 19th century Hotchkiss Revolving Cannon. A rapid-fire weapon used decisively in the Spanish American War.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: Jimmie at the Bat
programmes.d: A baseball signed by the legendary Jackie Robinson lands in the shop, but will Jimmie hit a home run or strike out during the negotiations?

A customer is surprised by the value of a disposable World War II handgun he won in a poker game. A crawfish boat lures Johnnie and Yankee to the swamp, while Jimmie checks out a 1915 Gibson dual harp guitar.
Tammie takes a swing at landing a signed Ted Williams baseball bat while Johnnie and Walt secure a 24-carat gold-plated M16 gun commemorating the capture of Saddam Hussein.
The gang heads into the field to check out a 1975 Mac fire truck. Meanwhile, a rusty railroad track from the Civil War enters the shop and Joker pops in with an antique popcorn machine.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: Where's the Fire?
programmes.d: The guys look to make deals on a beautifully restored 1929 Ford fire engine, a vintage Easy-Bake oven from the early 1970s that still works and 170 rooms of hotel furniture from the famous Bentley Hotel.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: Pair of Jokers
programmes.d: The guys bid on a timepiece once owned by Elvis and Joker returns to the shop with a furry friend to hunt down a deal.
While Mike and Frank pick the back roads of Minnesota, they challenge Danielle to sell a ten-foot fiberglass cowboy boot that's been gathering dust for over a year.
A former Georgia boxer fights to keep a lifetime of stockpiled stuff but his wife is fed up.
Mike and Frank visit a local legend in North Carolina. After picking through an accumulation of school busses and a burned-down storage house.

With a sprawling warehouse and overstuffed semi trailers, Kevin's New England property is a gold mine where Mike makes off with the Michelin man and then gambles on a rare collection of vintage pilot gear.
Out in Washington State, Mike and his brother Robbie stop off for a quick freestyle and come across a 1915 Harley.

The guys are in Kentucky, and they're driving Danielle crazy. Whenever she comes up with a new lead, they toss a coin to decide whether or not they'll go. At their first stop, the guys pick the storage locker of a fellow picker named 2D.
In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.
Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.
In London for the Prime Minister's funeral, Mike Banning is caught up in a plot to assassinate all the attending world leaders.
This sexy sequel to EL MARIACHI follows a mysterious guitar player (Antonio Banderas) as he seeks vengeance against the men who murdered his girlfriend.

Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?
Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.
In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.
The machete-wielding federale returns in this sequel, which pits him against a maniacal arms dealer and a revolutionary in a violent battle.
Sydney tells Vaughn what she learned about Jack in Wittenburg.
A special computer is stolen from NSA headquarters.
Sydney tries to buy a bio-weapon called Ice 5.
Sydney and Vaughn pose as Chechen spies in Russia.
Sydney begins hallucinating after being bitten by a man.
An American diplomat is killed while being used as a pawn in a dangerous drug ring, and the team must work together to bring them down.

When a controversial senior leader from Egypt comes to New York for a heart transplant, OA struggles to balance his personal opinion with his professional duty when he is assigned to the security detail.
After a decorated FBI agent is murdered, the team investigates and uncovers the man who led a double life.
A woman with information about the death of Maggie's husband is abducted leading the team to uncover a criminal operation larger than anyone imagined.
After a bomb detonates at a restaurant in Queens, the case becomes personal for OA, who grew up eating there.
Michael helps an ex-CIA operative who has become a target of Russian spies.
Michael, Sam, and Jesse must try to rescue Fiona when their plan to protect a wealthy business bigwig at his house party goes horribly awry.
Michael impersonates a hitman to protect the target, a crucial witness to criminal activity.
Michael infiltrates a high-security prison to protect an inmate (a good friend of Sam's) who is marked for death by a fellow prisoner.
Michael and team come to the aid of a woman who has her entire life savings wiped out by a sleazy womanizer.
Michael aids a criminal defense attorney in rescuing his daughter after a client kidnaps her.
A vengeful lawyer hires a paranoid bombmaker to eliminate members of a local gang, prompting Michael to intervene before innocent lives are lost in the ensuing chaos.
Mr. Wilford has arrived. And as this new threat rattles Snowpiercer to its core, Melanie makes a move that can't be undone.
An exchange is made between the two trains, but a greater revelation might be just over the horizon.

When the Monkey King's sacred homeland of Shangri-La is taken over by a ruthless collector of magical artifacts, the balance of the Universe is put in jeopardy, forcing all the Librarians to come together to help save the imperiled land.
The Librarians'two-frontbattle comes to a head when the Library is simultaneously infiltrated by DOSA and Apep.

When a secret sect of the Vatican Church unearths an ancient map detailing the locations of the four cornerstones of the Library of Alexandria (the original Library), it's up to Flynn and the Librarians to stop them.
When people begin getting hurt in the unluckiest of ways, the Librarians are led to a casino where the owner appears to possess an artifact capable of stealing people's luck.
When Santa takes Flynn, Baird and Jenkins on his first vacation in centuries, he leaves his beloved sleigh in the care of the Librarians.
When Flynn and Baird are sucked into Baird's favorite classic Film Noir movie, the Librarians are drawn into the world of movie magic.
After being betrayed, Clarke takes matters into her own hands and proves she's not going down without a flight.  Bellamy, Finn and Murphy race against time to save a stranger.
While Kane (HENRY IAN CUSICK) leads a mission to make peace with the Grounders, Lincoln (RICKY WHITTLE) enters a world of pain.  And Finn's search for Clarke takes a violent turn.
Tensions run high between Clarke & Finn, while Octavia faces her worst nightmare.  As Jasper & Monty discover the truth about Mt. Weather, Wallace is about to be betrayed.
Clarke comes up with a bold new plan to stop the Grounders' attack, leading Abby to a desperate decision.  Meanwhile, Jasper & Monty question the motives of their new friends.
Clarke returns to Camp Jaha with devastating news.  Finn struggles with the aftermath of his actions.  Abby gathers information from an unlikely source and prepares for a fight.
Clarke strikes a deal with Lexa & Indra, while a seething Raven is unable to control her emotions. A move threatens to destroy the alliance between the Sky People & the Grounders.
Clarke and Lexa encounter a new enemy, while Bellamy and Lincoln team up to break into Mt. Weather.  Meanwhile, Murphy helps Jaha confront his past, Indra makes Octavia an offer.
Bellamy and Lincoln's attempt to sneak into Mount Weather has brutal consequences, while Abby fights to stay in control as Clarke steps up in her new leadership role.
Felicity's frantic when she learns that Ray Palmer (Brandon Routh) is alive and being held by Damien Darhk. Sara joins the team on a rescue mission for Ray.
Near, along with the SPK, meets Light and the task force at a warehouse for the final showdown.
Though Mikami has written all the investigators' names in the Death Note, a minute passes and everyone is still alive.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shining D (Diamond) is Unbreakable, Part 1
programmes.d: Hayato’s attempt to kill Kira using Stray Cat’s air bullet ends in failure. Kira realizes that letting Hayato repeat the same morning is becoming a risk, so he decides to undo Bites the Dust after he sees through Rohan’s death.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Shining D (Diamond) is Unbreakable, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke and Hayato hide inside a nearby residence to escape from Deadly Queen and Stray Cat’s attack. But to their horror, Kira is somehow able to close in on them from outside the house.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Goodbye, Morioh – The Heart of Gold
programmes.st: Goodbye, Morioh – The Heart of Gold
programmes.d: Josuke and his friends have finally cornered Yoshikage Kira. Refusing to give up, Kira tries to activate Bites the Dust one more time to escape his desperate situation. Can Josuke and the others stop Kira in time to save the future of Morioh?

Amid the gritty beauty of Neapolis, the Joestar lineage lives on in Giorno Giovanna. After sidestepping long-term Joestar ally Koichi Hirose, Giorno must contend with two powerful Mafia gangsters, Leaky Eye Lucca and the enigmatic Bruno Bucciarati.

Eager to identify Leaky Eye Luca’s attacker, Bucciarati confronts Giorno and unleashes a Stand attack to dismantle him piece by piece. But Giorno counters with his Stand Golden Wind, surprising not just his adversary, but also himself.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Meet the Gangster Behind the Wall
programmes.st: Meet the Gangster Behind the Wall
programmes.d: Determined to join the mafia gang Passione, altruistic Giorno is introduced by Bucciarati to the grotesquely corpulent Polpo, an incarcerated capo who tests Giorno’s loyalty with a simple but bizarrely lethal test involving a lighter and its flame.

Plodding amid the dusky shadows of a peaceful piazza is Polpo’s macabre Stand, which assails any who dare witness the reigniting of the lighter. Giorno deciphers its method of attack, but is soon staring death in the face as Koichi comes to his aid.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Find Polpo's Fortune!
programmes.d: While word of the high-ranking capo Polpo’s alleged suicide sparks astonishment and speculation in the crime syndicate Passione, Giorno is inducted into Bucciarati’s eclectic mafia family. The only problem now is the vast fortune seemingly up for grabs.

Sailing to the Isle of Capri to recover Polpo’s estate, Bucciarati and team are ambushed by a stealthy enemy Stand that deflates them into rubber-like human pelts. Abbacchio, however, thinks he can find his comrades and reluctantly activates his Stand.

Having beheaded their captor by zipper, the team learns its plan has been leaked to Zucchero’s cohort, who is lying in wait on Capri. With fish and gun, Giorno and Mista swim to the island to beat the boat and weed out their assassin-in-waiting.
Saitama's a guy who’s a hero out of boredom. After saving a child from certain death, he decided to become a hero and trained hard for three years to become 'One Punch Man.'
A monster is moving toward City Z, one created by the mysterious organization known as 'The House of Evolution.'
Saitama and Genos glean information about The House of Evolution and its founder, Dr. Genus.
Battlesuit-clad terrorists called "The Paradisers" appear in City F, led by an enormous man known as Hammerhead.
Though he's been doing the hero gig for three years, Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him.
It's been five days since Saitama became a professional hero, and he has yet to do anything heroic.
An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z. Genos decides it's up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.
A pack of monsters calling themselves the "Clan of the Seafolk" arrives on the shores of City J, intent on invading the land.
As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot's brutal attacks.
Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger threatening the Earth.
As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S-Class heroes.
The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama!
Sitch attempts to recruit various cutthroats, villains, and assassins of the underworld to help the Hero Association.
Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association, Hellish Blizzard issues an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master’s stalker.
Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S-Class hero 'Tanktop Master.'
Metal Bat guards some VIPs while Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament.
The Monster Association launches simultaneous attacks on all human cities, attempting to overwhelm the Hero Association's forces.
The Super Fight tournament kicks off while Genos takes on multiple monsters who have appeared in City C.
As the Super Fight tournament heads for its grand finale, the Class S heroes battle to hold back the tide of monster incursions.
Goketsu, the first Super Fight Tournament champion, arrives in the stadium. He’s aiming to force the competitors to turn into monsters themselves.
Suiryu finds himself in the depths of despair. Despite all Saitama’s strength, there’s still something bugging the hero that he just can’t shake.

2029 – A female government cyber agent and the Internal Bureau of Investigations are hot on the trail of a "The Puppet Master" – a computer virus capable of invading cybernetic brains and altering its victim’s memory.
Ichigo and his fellow Soul Reapers must save two worlds from annihilation.
After the treasured Ouin is stolen, Toshiro Hitsugaya disappears and becomes suspected of treason.
Ichigo must fight a lonely battle to save Rukia before the two are forced to part ways forever!
Ichigo must travel into the depths of Hell to save his younger sister Yuzu.
A secret police force known as the Black Guard protects the boundary between the human world and the demon world.
Heroic Yugi squares off against archrival Kaiba in an adventure even more dangerous when the imaginary monsters in their playing cards become ferociously real…and when an old evil enters the fray.
It's a whole new deal! For the first time, Yugi, Jaden & Yusei are together in an all-new adventure!

programmes.t: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions
programmes.d: The stakes have never been higher, the rivalries never as fierce, the risks never so great. One wrong move - one card short - and it's game over for good.

Faced with eighty metre high cliffs and some of the roughest waters in the world, the team will have to put their bodies on the line and overcome their deepest fears if they are to succeed in their expedition.
The boys travel to Nepal in search of Charlie's dream fish, the Golden Mahseer. Able to detect imminent avalanches and earthquakes, Mahseer have extremely highly developed senses.
The Fishing Impossible team head to Mozambique to take on the world's ultimate spear fishing challenge. Their mission is to spear a powerful dogtooth tuna at St Lazarus Banks.

The Fishing Impossible team are on the trail of one of the most elegant apex predators in the ocean, the beautiful Blue Shark. The mission takes the boys to the unlikeliest of locations, Cornwall - south west of the UK.

Jay, Blowfish and Charlie's mission takes them to Kenya in search of Africa's largest freshwater fish, the Nile Perch. To catch it they'll endure a 500 kilometre bone-shaking drive across some of Kenya's toughest terrain.
This special profiles the extraordinary stories of three ordinary people who literally died and then came back to life.
A missionary working in Haiti is ambushed, shot and held for ransom by a gang. A tunneler returns to an underground shaft minutes after escaping to rescue two colleagues from the flooded cavity.
Attacked in her home by her mother's boyfriend, a 17-year-old girl fights to stay alive after having her throat cut.
A soldier's New Year's Eve turns into a nightmare when another soldier tries to kill him.
A young girl is turned into a sexual slave for a self-proclaimed prophet. An idealistic young man is brainwashed by a dangerous and racist cult.

Pati spends a day in Sonora’s capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city’s best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille, to a meat lover’s feast with the owner of the popular restaurant Mochomos.

Pati experiences two important Sonoran culinary traditions. First, on the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen receive 'the blessing' from a woman from the Seri tribe before heading out on the water to catch giant sea scallops.

Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It’s an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together. Back home, Pati throws a carne asada in her backyard for her husband and boys.

Sonoran wheat has shaped the cuisine of the entire Mexican north and is a staple of Sonoran cuisine. Pati tours one of Hermosillo’s oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery.

Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he’ll love – beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

Pati travels to Sonora’s coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes, each one a meal in itself: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta, and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

programmes.st: Cooking for my Crew in Sonora
programmes.d: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico’s vast state of Sonora, she’s inspired by the bold flavors and ingredients. They stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo, where Pati prepares her take on a true Sonoran feast.

Pati is inspired by Sonora’s 'northern flavors' where the hot, arid desert lends itself to hearty and surprising recipes. She makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, & cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with pickled grape salad.

Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco’s capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city’s most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city’s best chefs, Fabian Delgado.

Guadalajara is the cultural epicenter of Jalisco, drawing some of the most creative artists, musicians and chefs from all over Mexico. Pati explores some unique spots where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen.

Pati stops at a couple of beloved restaurants in Guadalajara for two classic dishes. At Super Menuderia Cano, she learns the secrets to their menudo that’s so good people line up down the block waiting to get in.
Some say that Jalisco is the birthplace of Mariachi. Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind that beloved music that pulls at the heartstrings of so many Mexicans.

Pati experiences a unique and storied part of this part of Jalisco’s charro culture: the Escaramuza. An all-female horse riding and skills competition honoring the woman charros who fought for Mexico’s independence.

Vanessa and Mohamad search for Dylan as Dmitri's citadel crumbles around them. Flesh acquires an unexpected ally in one of the Resistance Fighters. Taka clashes with the Vampire Elite.
Vanessa fights to get her daughter out of the citadel. Dmitri and Antanasia hatch a plot to stop Vanessa. Mohamad risks his life to save Vanessa and Dylan.
Vanessa makes a horrific decision to save her daughter. Axel and a former ally struggle to survive in the wild.. A group of juvenile delinquents come face to face with a sadistic vampire.
Vanessa encounters a group of vampires whose gruesome methods bring savagery to a new level. The Juvenile Delinquents continue their game of cat and mouse with Sam that has deadly consequences.

programmes.t: From Dusk Till Dawn 3: Hangman's Daughter
programmes.d: Set in Mexico in the early 1900s, this prequel to the From Dusk Till Dawn series finds outlaw Johnny Madrid on the run from the hangman, with the hangman's daughter Esmeralda by his side. Together they are faced with the fight of their lives.
Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

Jennifer Lopez: Dance Again combines riveting musical performances with a raw and candid look at Lopez's personal and professional life over a defining six-month period, when she challenges herself to go on tour with her two young children in tow.
A Mexican-American master chef and father to three daughters has lost his taste for food but not for life.

programmes.t: In the Time of the Butterflies
programmes.d: Salma Hayek gives a powerful, passionate performance as an idealistic young woman who wages a daring struggle for freedom against a murderous dictator (Edward James Olmos) in this moving thriller that tells of the personal toll of political tyranny.

As single mom Grace juggles work, bills, and her affair with a married doctor, her daughter, Ansiedad, plots a shortcut to adulthood after finding inspiration in the coming-of-age stories she's reading for school.

When a power-crazed despot schemes to buy California from Mexico, it takes two Zorros--the legendary Don Diego de la Vega and his chosen successor Alejandro Murrieta, a dashing bandit-turned-hero-- to defeat the tyrant's unscrupulous plans.

Despite trying to keep his swashbuckling to a minimum, a threat to California's pending statehood causes the adventure-loving Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) - and his wife, Elena (Zeta-Jones) - to take action.
Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.
Theseus was the fruit of dual paternity: Aegeus King of Athens slept with Aethra when she had just been raped by Poseidon, God of the Sea.
Taking revenge against Prometheus, Zeus created the first woman - the beautiful Pandora. He gave her a manipulative and deceptive character and subjected Prometheus to terrible torture.
As the Gestapo chief in Lyon, Klaus Barbie has the blood of 10,000 French Jews on his hands.
As one of the highest-ranking Gestapo officers in Rome during the war, Erich Priebke is responsible for one of Italy's worst atrocities.

In homes across America, there were images of unimaginable violence: four white police officers viciously beat a man on the ground. Years of accusations of police brutality suddenly became flesh and blood in a man named Rodney King.

In l966 Charles Whitmore barricaded himself in the bell tower at the University of Texas and randomly shot 31 people as they walked the college campus.
Journalist Jamie Theakston explores one of the darker beliefs in modern society.
Follow Jamie as he attempts to get a better understanding of this dark and sinister cult.

programmes.st: Search for the Real King Arthur
programmes.d: Follow Jamie Theakston as he searches the archives for mention of the 'Historical' King Arthur.
How Prohibition led to stock car racing
Hear the story of 'Walking Tall fame' Buford Pusser, the one man who was willing to take on the Dixie Mafia from his daughter, Dwana, as she discusses her daddy's heroic life and tragic death.

From the muskets of the Revolutionary War to the high-powered assault weapons of the late 20th Century, guns -- and the "Right Of The People To Keep And Bear Arms" -- have been as American as apple pie.
This episode captures Apollo’s most amazing video and audio moments caught on camera including the famous John F. Kennedy speech at Rice University where he inspires the nation to reach the moon.
This episode features the important “firsts” of the Apollo program. From the first satellite launched by the Soviets called Sputnick; to the first man who flew in space named Yuri Gagarin.

This episode chronicles several of the major decisions that define the Apollo mission including the decision to use a lunar module that detached from the command module rather than one giant spaceship landing on the moon.

programmes.st: Cleopatra, the Conquest of Egypt’s Throne
programmes.d: The tomb of the last queen of Egypt has never been found, despite experts searching for centuries.
Jack the Ripper, the most famous serial killer in history, murdered five women on the streets of Whitechapel. And he got away with it. How?
Dr. Brown courts Linda, despite Edna and Dr. Abbott's insistence that he's wasting his time. Meanwhile, Bright tells Ephram to ignore Madison in order to win her affections.
Outraged to discover that Ephram and Madison have gotten romantically involved, Dr. Brown almost terminates her job. However, Madison quits, leaving the Browns with an unhappy holiday.
Within an hour of the discovery that Amy has run away from home, the authorities are at the Abbott house to scour for clues and interview her devastated parents and brother.
Dr. Brown tries to intervene when a bulimic high school champion wrestler puts his life in jeopardy. Bright is suspended from school after he fights with Amy's boyfriend, Tommy.
Distracted by her first fight with Tommy, Amy forgets to prepare her father's birthday dinner. Madison lies to Ephram about liking a love song he wrote, leading to an argument.
Ephram gets the wrong idea when Madison tells him her roommate is going to be out of town. Meanwhile, Amy decides she's ready to have sex with Tommy.
Zoe tricks Jonah (Travis Van Winkle) into spilling a secret about Brick. Wade and Lemon each try to prove they know what is best for the new Rammer Jammer.
Rose (Mckaley Miller) and Max (Nicholas Podany) play matchmaker for Zoe. Rob Huebel (Childrens Hospital) guest stars as a potential love interest.
In the season finale, Zoe decides to visit New York, but a medical emergency on the plane forces her to complete the trip with an unexpected companion. The band Gloriana performs.

programmes.st: Who Says You Can't Go Home
programmes.d: In the season premiere, after a summer in New York, Zoe is ready to move permanently, but first she must return to BlueBell. Lemon has a plan to help out Wade in front of Zoe.
Lavon and AnnaBeth invite Zoe and Joel (Josh Cooke) over for a quiet dinner, but when Lemon invites herself and Alabama's most eligible bachelor (Ryan Mcpartlin), things go awry.

programmes.st: Take This Job and Shove It
programmes.d: Lemon finds herself in hot water. George finds himself needing medical attention during a tutoring session with Lynly (Antoinette Robertson), forcing him to call Zoe for help.

programmes.st: Help Me Make It Through the Night
programmes.d: Lemon is blacklisted from the Junior League Halloween Masquerade party, but her Grandma Bettie (Maree Cheatham) helps out. Lavon has a surprise for his anniversary with AnnaBeth.

programmes.st: How Do You Like Me Now
programmes.d: Zoe tries to fix the town's perception of Joel (Josh Cooke). Lavon begs Lemon for help with the Gazebos of Alabama calendar. George and Lynly (Antoinette Robertson) work together.
Lemon receives an offer she may not be able to refuse. AnnaBeth seems eager for Lavon to go out of town, causing him to wonder why. Plus, is Zoe ready to face her extended family?
Zoe is leery of how much Joel (Josh Cooke) and Wade hang out. Lavon uses the excuse of coaching his track team to avoid talking to AnnaBeth. Antoinette Robertson appears as Lynly.
Zoe hosts a Hanukkah party. Lemon enlists George and Lynly (Antoinette Robertson) to help uncover information about one of Brick's exes. Danielle Bradbery performs.

After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.
Five friends have found the mysterious and fiercely powerful Book of the Dead, which releases a violent demon on a bloodthirsty quest to possess them all.
Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

When a news crew decides to trail a brave fire-fighting team, they never suspect that the first call for help they respond to that night may  be their last. Now they're trapped in an apartment complex sealed off by the government. Rating: R

Earlier tonight, a bizarre disease was unleashed in a run-down Los Angeles tenement... and no one got out alive. Yet something escaped. Now, aboard Flight 318, the first symptoms begin to show. Rating: R

Based on the best-selling horror action game, Silent Hill stars Radha Mitchell (Man on Fire) as Rose, a desperate mother who takes her adopted daughter, Sharon, to the town of Silent Hill in an attempt to cure her of her ailment.  Rating: R
After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programmes.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programmes.d: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.
A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.
The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

Pam is a 49-year-old alcoholic who has suffered a string of abusive, failed marriages and horrific molestation as a child.

Former addicts from the series past seasons come together in an intimate Los Angeles studio for a candid discussion. How did the intervention change their lives? What are the relationships with their families like now?
Al, a big guy with a big personality, is sacrificing his relationships with his wife and children to chase his out-of-control meth and painkiller addiction.

Ben, 25, experienced a childhood filled with domestic violence, homelessness, and isolation. He never got to fulfill the potential of his 170 I.Q. and found a new way to find comfort when he was in high school--a drug called DXM.
Michelle, 30, looks like an aging mother of two who takes a daily concoction of methadone, Xanax, and blood pressure pills.
To outsiders, Marci's family life seemed ideal. But while her mother worked, Marci was left home with her alcoholic father. She endured his abuse while her mother looked the other way.
Daniel could have pursued a career as an artist and songwriter, but a series of personal tragedies--culminating in his father's death--led him to abuse a dangerous combination of alcohol and meth.
A gregarious man with an intense personality, 32 year-old Sean's alcohol addiction is causing him to blackout and suffer seizures, which have his wife and family on edge.
As a timber cutter, Coley has one of the most dangerous jobs in America. But instead of taking serious precautions, he increases his risks every day by snorting crystal meth.
Heidi leads a busy social life and takes great pride in maintaining her health and personal appearance.
An ambitious inventor and entrepreneur, Benny once dreamed of becoming a millionaire. But stress, drugs, and alcohol have turned his dream into a nightmare.
Once bright, likable, and athletic, Andrew has become a gaunt, menacing OxyContin addict.
Ginjer is a professional Sugar Baby who trolls "dating" websites to maintain a severe Dilaudid addiction.
Anthony has been working at the pizzerias owned by his family since he was a kid. A good athlete, colleges offered him baseball scholarships. But at 14, everything changed.
A talented cellist and an aspiring music producer, Shane's musical aspirations are now out of reach because he abuses prescription drugs and deals drugs out of his grandmother's house.
Amanda's world was thrown into a tailspin when her husband went missing for months.
Karissa was always a talented cook--so much so, that her mother had one day hoped to pass the family diner down to her as a legacy.
The bloody battle for Stalingrad, Hitler's bridge too far.

programmes.st: The Battle of Kursk: Southern Front
programmes.d: The Battle of Kursk comes to a climax at the Russian village of Prokhorovka on July 12, 1943.

Discover the history and principles of guerrilla warfare, analyze the requirements of its Battleplan from two perspectives – those waging guerrilla warfare, and those opposing it.
Assault from the Air introduces a third dimension to a battlefield. The program focuses on the key requirements in a Battleplan for Assault from the Air and the changes that technology has brought.

The assassination of John F. Kennedy put a new leader in the driving seat of America's commitment to South Vietnam.
The first major battle of the war takes place at Ia Drang. Colonel Hal Moore leads the 1st Cavalry Division against hardened North Vietnamese regulars.
General Westmoreland executes his plan by unleashing America's advanced technology and firepower.
The war enters its fourth year. U.S. troop numbers and casualty lists spiral upward. At home, the war grows increasingly unpopular, and the government faces protests, riots, and assassinations.

While the U.S. supports new fighting on the borders, the long goodbye begins in Vietnam. The Ho Chi Minh Trail keeps fueling the fight, even as American forces depart.
Twenty years of war in Vietnam left many nations forever scarred. Although the helicopters were gone, many had not come home. The slow return of the U.S.

North Vietnamese troops close in on Saigon. Helicopters lift off from rooftops as the last U.S.

programmes.d: 'Black Week' 1943 sees the worst casualties to date with missions bombing ever deeper into Germany.

programmes.st: Morgan Fairchild, Lili Taylor, John Salley, Vincent Curatola
programmes.d: A young Morgan Fairchild is abused by a spirit when she moves into her new husband's family home.
Scientists believe that Stargates are doorways to wormholes in time. As it turns out, the government may have already known that.
The end is near. There have been signs and prophecies for centuries but it does feel like man's time on this planet is almost over. The question is: are you ready for Doomsday?
Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines a conspiracy that may be seeking to eradicate 90% of the world's population.
Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines whether the United States has been involved in a secret conflict with alien forces for the past fifty years.
Unsealed: Conspiracy Files examines whether the United State military has constructed flying saucers.
Unsealed: Conspiracy Files looks at how some world leaders throughout history have used impostors and doubles.
We rely on machines for virtually every aspect of modern life. Have we reached the point where we need them more than they need us.

Unsealed: Conspiracy Files counts down the top ten secret societies: (10) The Hellfire Club, (9) The Majestic Twelve, (8) The Knights of the Golden Circle, (7) Opus Dei, (6) The Bohemian Club, (5) ...

As the Fermi Paradox states, the possibilities that there is advanced life in the universe is surprisingly high. And if the universe is so old, why haven't we had any contact with extraterrestrial life?
In July of 2023, David Grusch, a former high ranking US Intelligence officer testified to a US government Oversight Committee that there are alien spacecraft located at secret facilities in the US.

Certain structures on our planet have stood the test of time and continue to astonish mankind. So much so, that alien intervention in their construction thousands of years ago, has yet to be ruled out.
In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight?
Investigate the Pacific Northwest, where new evidence of Sasquatch, Oregon wolf spirits, and Montana lake monsters emerge from the wild.
Desert ranchers face terror from Thunderbirds, Skinwalkers, and a Nightstalker, while a couple recounts their horrifying extraterrestrial encounter.
In Louisiana's Bayou, legends tell of the Honey Island Swamp Monster, the shape-shifting Rougarou, and the blood-sucking Vampires lurking in the shadows.
Rick and Marty Lagina make an exciting discovery after forging a truce with Dan Blankenship's longtime rival, Fred Nola.
After years of searching and speculation, the Lagina's and their team unearth evidence of what Marty believes proves the exact location of the ultimate target--The Money Pit.

Danger strikes just as the geo-tech drilling team hits a possible void in the Money Pit and the discovery of a long-lost artifact leads to an emotional reunion for one of the surviving members of the legendary Restall family.
Is Britain facing an alien invasion? Does it know more than it’s saying? And is it really dedicated to protecting its citizens? Or is it only protecting itself.
UFO sightings are a worldwide phenomenon.
There are structures as old as time that continue to baffle historians and engineers the world over. Did we build these ancient megaliths ourselves or did aliens guide our hand?
If aliens have visited Earth, why are they here and what are they truly after.
The list of global threats to the human race is long. But could Earth’s armed forces be facing a new enemy that is literally out of this world.
For decades, governments around the world have investigated UFO sightings, often times under an umbrella of secrecy. How are these top-secret studies conducted.
An extraterrestrial threat. A top secret organization. Has the US made contact with aliens? Experts believe they have. And an ultra top secret organization is calling all the shots.
Two vicious step-siblings of an elite Manhattan prep school make a wager: to deflower the new headmaster's daughter before the start of term.

programmes.t: One Night Out with Alan Cumming
programmes.d: Tony and Emmy Award-winning actor and icon Alan Cumming takes the Just For Laughs Montréal stage as host of a landmark comedy gala.
Season 6 premieres with 14 new queens competing to become America's Next Drag Superstar. But first they must face a death-defying photoshoot. With guest judge Adam Lambert and photographer Mike Ruiz.
The queens are challenged to create party-themed couture for a runway face-off. With guest judge Khloe Kardashian.
The queens put the 'fear' in 'fierce' as they act in a drag horror movie franchise. With guest judges Lena Headey (Game Of Thrones) and Linda Blair (The Exorcist).
The queens enter the world of musical theater. With guest judges composer Lucian Piane, and Sheryl Lee Ralph (Dream Girls).
The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show. With guest judges Gillian Jacobs (Community) and Heather McDonald (Chelsea Lately).
The queens are challenged to rap in a TLC-inspired 90s music video. Rap superstars Eve and Trina guest judge.
The queens book a big cosmetics gig, selling RuPaul's new makeup line. With guest judges Leah Remini (The King of Queens) and Lainie Kazan (My Big Fat Greek Wedding).
The queens must write and perform a stand-up comedy routine in front of a live audience. With guest judges Jaime Pressly (My Name Is Earl) and comedy writer Bruce Vilanch.
The queens host their very own talk show. With guest judges Paula Abdul, Chaz Bono, and singer (and Cher's mom) Georgia Holt.
The queens compete in a pageant of jewelry inspired couture. Guest judges Khloe Kardashian and legendary designer Bob Mackie return.
The queens compete in their final challenge - starring in the music video for RuPaul's hit 'Sissy That Walk.' With special guests Jamal Sims and Mathu Andersen.
A look back on the highlights, low-lights, and previously unseen footage as we race toward the climactic crowning of America's Next Drag Superstar.
Wigs fly as the queens return to discuss the drama of the season. Plus, both 'America's Next Drag Superstar' and 'Miss Congeniality' are crowned.

East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

Sylvester Stallone is back in this action-packed sequel, and this time he's up against an opponent (Antonio Tarver) who's faster, stronger, and 30 years his junior! Milo Ventimiglia and Burt Young are ringside for the hard-hitting battle of the ages!

Adonis Johnson (Michael B Jordan) never knew his father, heavyweight champion Apollo Creed, who died before he was born.  But, with boxing in his blood, he heads to Philadelphia to convince the retired Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) to train him.

The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life.  But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick-ass heroes.
Academy Award-winner Charlize Theron stars as Aeon Flux, the underground operative fighting totalitarian rule in 25th-century Earth's last living city.
Max Walker, an officer for a security agency that regulates time travel, must fend for his life against a shady politician who's intent on changing the past to control the future.
Frankenstein's monster becomes involved in a war between two immortal clans.
The "universal soldiers" must fight the whole army, when the military's supercomputer S.E.T.H gets out of control.

Unknown to the residents of Raccoon City, a huge underground bioengineering facility has accidentally unleashed the deadly T-virus. Now a team of highly-trained super commandos must race to isolate the T-virus before it overwhelms humanity.
Alice is back and forced to face off against an unstoppable, bioengineered killing machine in the action-packed sequel to the sci-fi smash hit.
If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

Britt Reid is a slacker by day, party animal by night... until he finds a serious career that's seriously cool: crime-fighting action hero. As the Green Hornet, he teams up with gadget wiz and martial arts master Kato to take down LA's underworld.

Fernando Aguirre, Chairman and CEO of Chiquita, one of the largest producers of fruits and vegetables in the world, is unable to perform a physically demanding job at their flagship factory and has to be removed from the line.
Todd Ricketts, one of the owners of the Chicago Cubs, goes undercover within one of baseball's most famous franchises and fights for the chance to redeem himself after being let go on the second day.
When Paul takes the day off work to play a round of golf with Mark, he leaves their mother, Alma, in charge of the day shift at their second restaurant "Alma Nove" -- much to her delight.
Mark solicits his cousin, Johnny Drama, and friend, Billy Leonard, to take Paul out for a weekend of physical activity when he sees that Paul is putting on a few extra pounds.

Alma Wahlberg's recipes have always been the talk of her family. Alma finally attempts to gather all of her kids' favorite recipes and share them with the public.Mark is up to his old childhood tricks when he hooks up with old buddy.
Donnie and Mark decide to play a practical joke on big brother Paul by telling him that they want to create a Wahlburgers jingle.

As Paul's birthday draws near, Donnie realizes that his brother is a workaholic. Forcing him to take a much deserved break, Donnie pulls out an old, beat up replica of Paul's favorite childhood car and takes him on a wild ride of brotherly bonding.

Mark's in for a wild time when he brings his real life entourage to LA for a little bit of fun in the sun. While there, Johnny Drama gets the chance of the lifetime when Mark surprises him with an audition for his new film.
It's summertime in Boston and the Wahlbergs are kicking it off with their annual family reunion. This year there is a lot to celebrate.

programmes.st: Has the Master Lost His Mojo
programmes.d: Jeff takes delivery of a massive load of dubious merchandise and his staff starts to worry. Meanwhile, a planned auction of high-end goods teeters on the brink of disaster.
Jeff is stressed out from making deals non-stop. After reaching a breaking point, he reluctantly lets his family take him on a vacation but struggles to relax.
Jeff negotiates for goods at an Italian gelato café that appears to have something brewing on the side. Jeff makes other deals for dodgy Chinese mattresses and wicker furniture.
Jeff finally decides to part with his beloved Motorcycle Monster statue and a fellow-collector tempts him with even more novelty attractions.

An Ohio customer fights fast food employees, apparently over a customized drink. A Scottish man has trouble ordering at an Alabama drive-thru. At a New York diner, a server tells off a customer. Thieves try to rob a gun store in Tennessee.
In Florida, a couple is booted from a flight after allegedly refusing to follow instructions. A young girl in California finds herself stuck in a gumball machine.
At a fast food restaurant in South Carolina, a man stands up to what he believes is a rude customer, and things quickly become physical.
A stubborn moviegoer refuses to give up his seat, causing employees to stop the movie and intervene. In Las Vegas, a rideshare driver is unexpectedly attacked by seven passengers.
A plate shatters on a woman's face during a brawl over restaurant seating. A passenger on a flight to Boston begins acting erratically and starts making his way toward the cockpit.

After allegedly skipping the bill at an airport restaurant in Atlanta, a customer causes chaos with a fire extinguisher. A bar patron keeps his cool in St. Louis, Missouri in the face of an armed robber.

Shane Evans, COO of Massage Heights, goes undercover to find the kinks in her company. One store's disregard for company policy rubs the Boss the wrong way. Can the boss of one of the largest massage chains in North America actually give a massage?

In the series first, a Native American Boss goes undercover. Bruce "Two Dogs" Bozsum, Chairman of Mohegan Sun Casino, goes all in while undercover inside his Indian gaming empire. Does the Boss have enough gas in the tank to work the valet line?

Joe Didomizio, CEO of Hudson Group, goes undercover to find out if his company is still the "traveler's best friend." What happens when this travel king discovers turmoil in the terminals? Will working as a barista prove too hot to handle for this boss?
The father/son team of Paul and Bogart splits up to go locker vs locker in Claireville. May the best Kenny win!

programmes.st: Big Cow Trouble in Little Ajax
programmes.d: The grand opening of Paul and Bogart’s store finally arrives, but a kink is put into their plans when a new buyer shows up on the scene with money to burn.
Tempers flare and prices soar as the buyers confront aggressive guest auctioneer Jeff Schwartz, aka “The Liquidator.”
Guest auctioneer Patrick Pecker brings “the full Pecker” to the auction, fuelling his longstanding feud with Roy.
Roy suits up in full army gear to declare war on the buyers in Scarborough.

Director James Bamford delivers non-stop action in Jade. A reluctant Shaina West (Black Widow) and Mark Dacascos (John Wick 3) square off against Mickey Rourke (The Wrestler) in an attempt to safeguard secrets that could destroy interpol.
With cases of demonic possession at an all-time high, the first female exorcist is called to save the soul of a young girl. But who, or what, has invited her?

programmes.t: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
programmes.d: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.
A mother tells a lie for her beloved son that rips apart their family and close-knit Irish town— ultimately testing her own sense of right and wrong in this tense, atmospheric thriller.
A small-town rabbi becomes an unlikely detective and gunfighter after his community is violently attacked in this sharp, high-stakes thriller packed with action, wit, and heart.
